631: function useMenuRow(rowRef: RefObject<HTMLLIElement | null>, isSubRow = false) {
632:   const scope = useContext(MenuScopeContext);
633:   const registerRow = scope?.registerRow;
634:   const setRowButton = scope?.setRowButton;
635:   const setRowActive = scope?.setRowActive;
636: 
637:   // The button's setActive effect can fire while this row's <li> ref is
638:   // detached: a child's layout effects run before its parent's ref attaches
639:   // — at mount, and on EVERY re-render whose inline ref identity changes
640:   // (React detaches the old callback, nulling the ref, before the layout
641:   // phase). The flag holds the truth through that window, and attachRow
642:   // re-syncs the scope whenever the <li> lands.
643:   const activeFlagRef = useRef(false);
644: 
645:   useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
646:     const el = rowRef.current;
647:     if (!el || !registerRow) return;
648:     return registerRow(el);
649:   }, [registerRow, rowRef]);
650: 
651:   /** The <li>'s ref callback: tracks the element and replays the active flag
652:    *  the scope may have missed while the ref was detached. */
653:   const attachRow = useCallback(
654:     (node: HTMLLIElement | null) => {
655:       rowRef.current = node;
656:       if (node && setRowActive) setRowActive(node, activeFlagRef.current);
657:     },
658:     [setRowActive, rowRef],
659:   );
660: 
661:   const setActive = useCallback(
662:     (active: boolean) => {
663:       activeFlagRef.current = active;
664:       if (rowRef.current && setRowActive) setRowActive(rowRef.current, active);
665:     },
666:     [setRowActive, rowRef],
667:   );
668: 
669:   const setButtonEl = useCallback(
670:     (el: HTMLElement | null) => {
671:       if (rowRef.current && setRowButton) setRowButton(rowRef.current, el);
672:     },
673:     [setRowButton, rowRef],
674:   );
675: 
676:   const isHovered =
677:     rowRef.current !== null && scope?.hoveredRowEl === rowRef.current;
678:   const isActiveRow =
679:     rowRef.current !== null &&
680:     (scope?.activeRows.includes(rowRef.current) ?? false);
681: 
682:   const [trailing, setTrailing] = useState({
683:     actionCount: 0,
684:     actionsShowOnHover: false,
685:     hasBadge: false,
686:   });
687:   const setActions = useCallback(
688:     (count: number, showOnHover: boolean) =>
689:       setTrailing((prev) =>
690:         prev.actionCount === count && prev.actionsShowOnHover === showOnHover
691:           ? prev
692:           : { ...prev, actionCount: count, actionsShowOnHover: showOnHover },
693:       ),
694:     [],
695:   );
696:   const setHasBadge = useCallback(
697:     (hasBadge: boolean) =>
698:       setTrailing((prev) =>
699:         prev.hasBadge === hasBadge ? prev : { ...prev, hasBadge },
700:       ),
701:     [],
702:   );
703: 
704:   return useMemo(
705:     () => ({
706:       rowRef,
707:       attachRow,
708:       isHovered,
709:       isActiveRow,
710:       isSubRow,
711:       setActive,
712:       setButtonEl,
713:       ...trailing,
714:       setActions,
715:       setHasBadge,
716:     }),
717:     [
718:       rowRef,
719:       attachRow,
720:       isHovered,
721:       isActiveRow,
722:       isSubRow,
723:       setActive,
724:       setButtonEl,
725:       trailing,
726:       setActions,
727:       setHasBadge,
728:     ],
729:   );
730: }

732: // ─── Trailing-gutter math ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
733: //
734: // The label reserves exactly the trailing run it has to clear, plus one gap
735: // — the same rule the section header's label follows, so a row's chevron and
736: // a section header's chevron each sit one 4px gap from their action run.
737: // A run is: the badge's 24px slot (rightmost when present), the action
738: // cluster (24px apiece, 4px between), and a gap where both appear.
739: const ROW_BASE_PAD = 8;
740: const ROW_SLOT = 24;
741: const ROW_GAP = 4;
742: /** Where the run's rightmost element sits, measured from the row's right
743:  *  edge: a badge at right-2, an action cluster at right-1.5 (its wider box
744:  *  puts both on the same centre line). */
745: const ROW_BADGE_INSET = 8;
746: const ROW_ACTION_INSET = 6;
747: 
748: function rowGutter(actionCount: number, hasBadge: boolean) {
749:   if (!actionCount && !hasBadge) return ROW_BASE_PAD;
750:   const actionsWidth = actionCount
751:     ? actionCount * ROW_SLOT + (actionCount - 1) * ROW_GAP
752:     : 0;
753:   const runWidth =
754:     (hasBadge ? ROW_SLOT : 0) +
755:     actionsWidth +
756:     (hasBadge && actionCount ? ROW_GAP : 0);
757:   const inset = hasBadge ? ROW_BADGE_INSET : ROW_ACTION_INSET;
758:   return inset + runWidth + ROW_GAP;
759: }

826: // ─── Row label (ghost-span weight animation) ─────────────────────────────────
827: 
828: /** Splits leading string children out as the label so it can get the
829:  *  ghost-span weight treatment; remaining element children (dots, trailing
830:  *  icons) render as flex siblings after it — outside the text-box-trimmed
831:  *  span, which would clip an inline SVG, and where `ml-auto` can push a
832:  *  trailing control to the row's end. */
833: function MenuRowLabel({
834:   content,
835:   lit,
836:   emphasized,
837:   textClass,
838: }: {
839:   content: ReactNode;
840:   lit: boolean;
841:   emphasized: boolean;
842:   textClass: string;
843: }) {
844:   const nodes = Children.toArray(content);
845:   const textParts: string[] = [];
846:   let i = 0;
847:   while (
848:     i < nodes.length &&
849:     (typeof nodes[i] === "string" || typeof nodes[i] === "number")
850:   ) {
851:     textParts.push(String(nodes[i]));
852:     i++;
853:   }
854:   const label = textParts.join("");
855:   const rest = nodes.slice(i);
856: 
857:   if (!label) {
858:     return (
859:       <span
860:         className={cn(
861:           "flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-2 transition-colors duration-80",
862:           lit ? "text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground",
863:           textClass,
864:         )}
865:       >
866:         {content}
867:       </span>
868:     );
869:   }
870: 
871:   return (
872:     <>
873:       <span className={cn("inline-grid min-w-0 text-left", textClass)}>
874:         {/* Ghost: reserves width at the heaviest weight, hidden from AT.
875:             Both cells truncate so a long label clips with an ellipsis
876:             instead of wrapping the row. The trim box spans cap height to
877:             baseline, so the overflow clip would shave ascenders and
878:             descenders — symmetric padding extends the clip box past both
879:             and the negative margins cancel it out of the row's height. */}
880:         <span
881:           className="col-start-1 row-start-1 invisible truncate pt-[0.25em] -mt-[0.25em] pb-[0.25em] -mb-[0.25em] [text-box:trim-both_cap_alphabetic]"
882:           style={{ fontVariationSettings: fontWeights.semibold }}
883:           aria-hidden="true"
884:         >
885:           {label}
886:         </span>
887:         {/* Visible: animates between weights in the same cell */}
888:         <span
889:           className={cn(
890:             "col-start-1 row-start-1 truncate pt-[0.25em] -mt-[0.25em] pb-[0.25em] -mb-[0.25em] transition-[color,font-variation-settings] duration-80 [text-box:trim-both_cap_alphabetic]",
891:             lit ? "text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground",
892:           )}
893:           style={{
894:             fontVariationSettings: emphasized
895:               ? fontWeights.semibold
896:               : fontWeights.normal,
897:           }}
898:         >
899:           {label}
900:         </span>
901:       </span>
902:       {rest}
903:     </>
904:   );
905: }

# Design: Schedule, Webhook, Recovery & Events Re-homing (commit 8)

Decision record for re-homing the 4 features the new 17-table schema dropped.
User-approved (2026-09-11). Guiding rule: **keep docs MVP scope; ADD missing
required features; never resurrect tables the SCHEMA.md folded elsewhere.**

## 1. Schedules — NEW table `schedules`

- **Why**: `createSchedule` capability + recurring monitors ("check every X")
  need a recurrence config the docs left implicit (`PG/SCHEDULE.md` only had
  `runs.trigger=schedule` + `runs.status=sleeping` + Inngest cron). Without a
  table, per-workflow recurrence config is impossible.
- **Table**: ports legacy `schedule` shape onto the new FK set —
  `sched_` ULID, `workspace_id`, `thread_id`, `user_id`, `cron`, `interval_seconds`,
  `next_run_at`, `last_run_at`, `last_run_id`, `enabled`, `config` jsonb,
  `created_at/updated_at`. Unique `(workspace_id, thread_id)`.
- **tick**: `schedule-tick` keeps its real Inngest cron trigger; body =
  scan `enabled + next_run_at <= now()` → fire `thread/run` (trigger=schedule,
  run_id saved to `schedules.last_run_id`) → advance `next_run_at`. Wakes
  `runs.status=sleeping` due too.
- RLS: owner OR workspace member (same as runs).

## 2. Durable webhooks — NEW table `webhook_hooks`

- **Why**: user wants the "run pauses until CI/webhook pings" flow kept
  (SCHEMA.md §17 had retired `webhook-board`/`waitForWebhook` from MVP). Keep it
  as a required feature scoped to runs (not workflows).
- **Table**: `whk_` ULID, `run_id` (ref runs), `workspace_id`, `thread_id`,
  `user_id`, `token_hash` (unique — WebCrypto SHA-256 of raw token; never raw),
  `status`(active|fired|expired), `expires_at`, `fired_at`, `consume_payload`
  jsonb (what the POST body resumes), `created_at`. `run_id` NOT unique —
  one run can mint several hooks.
- **Route** `POST /api/v1/hooks/[token]`: `WebhookHookService` consumes by
  token (hash → row), status active → set fired, then `runs` gateway change
  (sleeping/waiting → resume via inngest `thread/run` trigger=resume) + append
  payload to that run's `run_activities` (type=system).
- same Auth: none (token IS the secret). Expire check inside service.
- Kill: `webhookBoard` absence is fine — new table replaces legacy `webhook_board`.

## 3. Recovery attempts — NO table; folded into `run_activities`

- AUDIT praises bounded recovery (`recordRecoveryAttempt` boolean gate,
  `classifyFailure`, `RECOVERY_HINTS`). SCHEMA.md dropped `recovery_attempt`.
- **Home**: `run_activities` rows `type=system`, `step_label="recovery"`,
  `detail={attempt, failureClass, failureCode, strategy, result}`.
- Classifier (`classifyFailure`/`FailureClassification`, `RECOVERY_HINTS`) stays
  in pure module (`packages/agent/src/recovery.ts`) — no DB of its own.
- Bounded: `RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (server cap) enforced by runner per run;
  recovery attempt consult = count system/recovery activities on that run.

## 4. Events + observations — NO tables; absorbed in `run_activities`

- diff: old `event` = flat appened milestones (flow start/end/status), old
  `observation` = agent evidence (type+jsonb), old `agent_state` = god jsonb
  (plan+progress+activity snapshot). SCHEMA.md §10 already replaces all three.
- Milestone → `type=system`; observation → `type=system` + `detail`;
  plan/progress → `plans`/`plan_steps`; activity snapshot → the rows themselves.
- **Chosen**: run_activities wins (typed, realtime, RLS, drives ThinkingSteps).
  Do NOT resurrect event/observation/agent_state.

## 5. Inngest layout (packages/inngest/src/functions/)
```
execution-run.ts   DELETE (914 lines — regex decision parsing gone)
thread-runner.ts   the runner over runs + run_activities (streaming, cost
                   cap BEFORE steps, idempotent gate, recovery loop, sleep/
                   wait delegations, plan fetch, memory context)
schedule-tick.ts   real Inngest cron trigger: due schedules + sleeping wake
notification-notifier.ts  webhook delivery + in-app create
helpers/           recovery.ts classify / prompts.ts / memory.ts / usage.ts
```
- backlog: only `thread/run` event (+ `notification/publish` kept). All
  functions registered in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts`.
- `RunService` additions: `listSleepingDue`, `sleepUntil(detail)`,
  `resumeTriggeredBy`; plus `createActivity` `type=system` reuse for milestones.

## 6. Files
- `packages/db/src/schema/schedule.ts`, `webhook-hook.ts`, relations, ids.
- `packages/workflow/src/services/schedule-service.ts`,
  `webhook-hook-service.ts` (new services files).
- `packages/agent/src/capabilities/schedule-create.ts` → ScheduleService.
- `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts` → WebhookHookService.
- `packages/inngest` function split (above).
- ENV keeps `WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` + `RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (still used).

To deliver OUTSIDE the app, set "channel":"webhook" and put the destination in "body":{"url":"https://..."} (the payload is POSTed to that URL; the user's notification bell also records it).
75: - {"action":"stop","reason":"..."} to cancel this run.
76: - {"action":"wait","waitFor":{"description":"<what external event this run waits for>","expiresInSeconds":<optional, 60..2592000>},"notification":{"type":"webhook","subject":"...","body":{...}}} to pause this run on a durable webhook. The user is told the webhook URL; when they POST to it, this run resumes with the payload handed back as instruction context.
77: - {"action":"complete","reason":"<concise evidence of what was accomplished>","observation":{"type":"...","content":{...}},"planProgress":{"currentStep":<index+1>,"status":"completed"}} to finish.
78: 
79: Plan progress: when a stored plan exists, a decision block may include "planProgress":{"currentStep":<number of steps fully done, 0 or more>,"status":"in_progress"|"completed"}. Emit it whenever a step finishes; the final complete must set "status":"completed". The UI renders this as live progress against the stored plan.
80: 
81: Verification: before emitting complete for an objective that depends on the outside world, make one verification tool call (re-check the page/price/status) and include the observation evidence in the reason. Do not claim completion you did not verify.
82: 
83: If no decision block is needed (the normal case, e.g. objective finished), emit none and the run is marked complete. Keep your visible answer plain text.`;
84:

116: function recoveryBlock(context: {
117: 	attempt: number;
118: 	failureCode?: string;
119: 	failureMessage?: string;
120: }): string {
121: 	const hint = context.failureCode
122: 		? RECOVERY_HINTS[context.failureCode]
123: 		: undefined;
124: 	return `This run is a bounded recovery attempt (attempt ${context.attempt}) after a previous failure: ${context.failureMessage ?? context.failureCode ?? "unknown error"}.
125: ${hint ? `Targeted guidance for ${context.failureCode}: ${hint}` : "Diagnose, adjust your approach, and continue the original objective."}
126: Treat any retrieval from procedural memory as the proven way forward and reuse it. Do not start new consequential side effects speculatively. Successfully completed tool results from the previous attempt are replayed to you instead of being re-invoked — do not re-run them.`;
127: }

129: async function buildConversationInstructions(
130: 	workflowId: string,
131: 	executionId: string,
132: 	maxChars: number | undefined,
133: 	mode: "planning" | "run",
134: 	recoveryContext?: {
135: 		attempt: number;
136: 		failureCode?: string;
137: 		failureMessage?: string;
138: 	},
139: ): Promise<string | undefined> {

141: 		workflowId,
142: 		executionId,
143: 		maxChars,
144: 	);
145: 	if (mode === "planning") {
146: 		const base = PLANNING_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS;
147: 		return context ? `${base}\n\n${context}` : base;
148: 	}
149: 	let base = RUN_DECISION_INSTRUCTIONS;
150: 	if (recoveryContext) {
151: 		base = `${base}\n\n${recoveryBlock(recoveryContext)}`;

275: /**
276:  * Bounded recovery: classify the failure, record the attempt (idempotent per
277:  * (executionId, attempt)), and re-enqueue the same execution with a
278:  * recoveryContext the next run can see. Re-enqueues only when THIS call was
279:  * the one that recorded the attempt, so concurrent failure handlers cannot
280:  * double-schedule. Fatal failures or attempts past RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS fall
281:  * through to a durable fail.
282:  */
283: async function maybeScheduleRecovery(
284: 	parsed: z.infer<typeof executionRunEventSchema>,
285: 	failure: { code: string; reason: string },
286: ): Promise<boolean> {
287: 	const classification = classifyFailure({ code: failure.code });
288: 	const attempts = await workflowService.countRecoveryAttempts(
289: 		parsed.executionId,
290: 	);
291: 	const attempt = attempts + 1;
292: 	if (
293: 		classification.failureClass === "fatal" ||
294: 		attempt > env.RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
295: 	) {
296: 		await workflowService.recordRecoveryAttempt({
297: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
298: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
299: 			failureClass: classification.failureClass,
300: 			failureCode: classification.failureCode,
301: 			attempt,
302: 			strategy: "fail-safe",
303: 			result: "failed",
304: 			detail: { reason: failure.reason },
305: 		});
306: 		await workflowService.failExecution({
307: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
308: 			reason: failure.reason,
309: 		});
310: 		await notifyFailure(
311: 			parsed.workflowId,
312: 			classification.failureClass,
313: 			classification.failureCode,
314: 			failure.reason,
315: 		);
316: 		return false;
317: 	}
318: 	const recorded = await workflowService.recordRecoveryAttempt({
319: 		workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
320: 		executionId: parsed.executionId,
321: 		failureClass: classification.failureClass,
322: 		failureCode: classification.failureCode,
323: 		attempt,
324: 		strategy: "bounded-retry",
325: 		result: "started",
326: 		detail: { reason: failure.reason },
327: 	});
328: 	if (!recorded) {
329: 		return true;
330: 	}
331: 	await inngest.send({
332: 		name: executionRunEvent,
333: 		data: {
334: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
335: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
336: 			prompt: parsed.prompt,
337: 			modelContextCapChars: parsed.modelContextCapChars,
338: 			recoveryContext: {
339: 				failureCode: classification.failureCode,
340: 				failureMessage: failure.reason,
341: 				attempt,
342: 			},
343: 		},
344: 	});
345: 	return true;
346: }

348: function createActivityAccumulator(workflowId: string, executionId: string) {
349: 	const snapshot: ActivitySnapshot = {
350: 		status: "running",
351: 		currentActivity: "starting",
352: 		executionId,
353: 		steps: [],
354: 		tools: [],
355: 		updatedAt: new Date(),
356: 	};
357: 	let toolCounter = 0;
358: 	const persistTool = (
359: 		activity: Extract<
360: 			AgentActivity,
361: 			{ type: "tool-start" } | { type: "tool-end" }
362: 		>,
363: 		order: number,
364: 	) =>
365: 		workflowService.upsertToolActivity({
366: 			workflowId,
367: 			executionId,
368: 			order,
369: 			tool: activity.tool,
370: 			status: activity.type === "tool-start" ? "called" : activity.status,
371: 			input:
372: 				activity.type === "tool-start"
373: 					? (activity.input as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)
374: 					: undefined,
375: 		});
376: 	return {
377: 		apply(activity: AgentActivity): void {
378: 			snapshot.updatedAt = new Date();
379: 			switch (activity.type) {
380: 				case "tool-start": {
381: 					const order = toolCounter++;
382: 					void persistTool(activity, order).catch(() => {});
383: 					snapshot.tools.push({
384: 						order,
385: 						step: snapshot.steps.length,
386: 						tool: activity.tool,
387: 						status: "running",
388: 					});
389: 					snapshot.currentActivity = `running ${activity.tool}`;
390: 					break;
391: 				}
392: 				case "tool-end": {
393: 					const entry = snapshot.tools.find(
394: 						(t) => t.tool === activity.tool && t.status === "running",
395: 					);
396: 					if (entry) {
397: 						entry.status = activity.status;
398: 						void persistTool(activity, entry.order).catch(() => {});
399: 					}
400: 					snapshot.currentActivity = undefined;
401: 					break;
402: 				}
403: 				case "step-end": {
404: 					snapshot.steps = snapshot.steps.filter(
405: 						(s) => s.order !== activity.step,
406: 					);
407: 					snapshot.steps.push({
408: 						order: activity.step,
409: 						text: activity.text,
410: 					});
411: 					snapshot.steps.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
412: 					snapshot.currentActivity = "summarizing";
413: 					break;
414: 				}
415: 			}
416: 		},
417: 		snapshot() {
418: 			return {
419: 				...snapshot,
420: 				steps: [...snapshot.steps],
421: 				tools: [...snapshot.tools],
422: 			};
423: 		},
424: 	};
425: }

427: /**
428:  * Idempotent gate: if the execution is already in a terminal state, or is
429:  * sleeping (a durable sleep decision is pending), the run must be a no-op.
430:  * Returning "skipped" prevents a retry or duplicate event from re-executing
431:  * the same unit of work twice.
432:  */
433: export async function resolveExecutionState(data: unknown): Promise<{
434: 	workflowId: string;
435: 	executionId: string;
436: 	state: "run" | "skipped";
437: 	reason?: string;
438: }> {
439: 	const parsed = executionRunEventSchema.parse(data);
440: 	const execution = await workflowService.getExecution(parsed.executionId);
441: 	if (!execution) {
442: 		throw new NonRetriableError(`Execution not found: ${parsed.executionId}`);
443: 	}
444: 	if (
445: 		execution.status === "completed" ||
446: 		execution.status === "failed" ||
447: 		execution.status === "cancelled" ||
448: 		execution.status === "sleeping" ||
449: 		execution.status === "waiting"
450: 	) {
451: 		return {
452: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
453: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
454: 			state: "skipped",
455: 			reason: `execution already ${execution.status}`,
456: 		};
457: 	}
458: 	return {
459: 		workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
460: 		executionId: parsed.executionId,
461: 		state: "run",
462: 	};
463: }

465: export async function runAgentStep(data: unknown): Promise<{
466: 	workflowId: string;
467: 	executionId: string;
468: 	status: "running" | "skipped";
469: 	mode: "planning" | "run";
470: 	reason?: string;
471: 	result?: AgentResult;
472: 	recoveryContext?: {
473: 		failureCode?: string;
474: 		failureMessage?: string;
475: 		attempt: number;
476: 	};
477: }> {
478: 	const parsed = executionRunEventSchema.parse(data);
479: 	const execution = await workflowService.getExecution(parsed.executionId);
480: 	if (!execution) {
481: 		throw new NonRetriableError(`Execution not found: ${parsed.executionId}`);
482: 	}
483: 	if (
484: 		execution.status === "completed" ||
485: 		execution.status === "failed" ||
486: 		execution.status === "cancelled"
487: 	) {
488: 		return {
489: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
490: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
491: 			status: "skipped",
492: 			mode: "run",
493: 			reason: `execution already ${execution.status}`,
494: 		};
495: 	}
496: 	if (execution.status === "sleeping") {
497: 		return {
498: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
499: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
500: 			status: "skipped",
501: 			mode: "run",
502: 			reason: "execution sleeping",
503: 		};
504: 	}
505: 	if (execution.status === "waiting") {
506: 		return {
507: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
508: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
509: 			status: "skipped",
510: 			mode: "run",
511: 			reason: "execution waiting on webhook",
512: 		};
513: 	}
514: 	if (execution.status === "awaiting_approval") {
515: 		return {
516: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
517: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
518: 			status: "skipped",
519: 			mode: "run",
520: 			reason: "execution awaiting user approval",
521: 		};
522: 	}
523: 	const elapsedSeconds = execution.startedAt
524: 		? (Date.now() - execution.startedAt.getTime()) / 1000
525: 		: 0;
526: 	if (elapsedSeconds > env.EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS) {
527: 		const reason = `execution exceeded the ${env.EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS}s wall-clock budget`;
528: 		const scheduled = await maybeScheduleRecovery(parsed, {
529: 			code: "EXECUTION_TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
530: 			reason,
531: 		});
532: 		return {
533: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
534: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
535: 			status: "skipped",
536: 			mode: "run",
537: 			reason: scheduled
538: 				? "recovery scheduled after time budget exceeded"
539: 				: reason,
540: 		};
541: 	}
542: 	const workflow = await workflowService.getWorkflowById(execution.workflowId);
543: 	if (!workflow) {
544: 		throw new NonRetriableError(`Workflow not found: ${execution.workflowId}`);
545: 	}
546: 	const mode: "planning" | "run" =
547: 		workflow.status === "draft" ? "planning" : "run";
548: 	const activity = createActivityAccumulator(workflow.id, parsed.executionId);
549: 	const replay =
550: 		parsed.recoveryContext !== undefined
551: 			? await workflowService.listReplayableToolOutputs(parsed.executionId)
552: 			: undefined;
553: 	const result = await runAgent({
554: 		registry:
555: 			mode === "planning"
556: 				? createPlanningRegistry()
557: 				: withExecutionCapabilities(
558: 						createDefaultRegistry(),
559: 						workflow.id,
560: 						workflow.userId,
561: 					),
562: 		objective: parsed.prompt,
563: 		maxSteps: env.AGENT_MAX_STEPS,
564: 		modelContextCapChars: parsed.modelContextCapChars,
565: 		instructions: await buildConversationInstructions(
566: 			workflow.id,
567: 			parsed.executionId,
568: 			parsed.modelContextCapChars,
569: 			mode,
570: 			parsed.recoveryContext,
571: 		),
572: 		onActivity: async (next) => {
573: 			activity.apply(next);
574: 			await workflowService.updateActivitySnapshot(
575: 				parsed.workflowId,
576: 				activity.snapshot(),
577: 			);
578: 		},
579: 		replayedToolOutputs: replay,
580: 		approvedToolNames: parsed.approvedToolNames,
581: 	});
582: 	const toolCallCount = result.steps.reduce(
583: 		(count, step) => count + step.toolCalls.length,
584: 		0,
585: 	);
586: 	try {
587: 		await workflowService.recordUsage(parsed.executionId, {
588: 			tokenCount: result.usage.totalTokens,
589: 			costUsd: result.usage.costUsd,
590: 		});
591: 	} catch {
592: 		// Usage persistence is best-effort and never fails a run.
593: 	}
594: 	if (result.usage.costUsd > env.EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD) {
595: 		const reason = `run exceeded the $${env.EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD} cost budget ($${result.usage.costUsd.toFixed(6)})`;
596: 		const scheduled = await maybeScheduleRecovery(parsed, {
597: 			code: "EXECUTION_COST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
598: 			reason,
599: 		});
600: 		return {
601: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
602: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
603: 			status: "skipped",
604: 			mode,
605: 			recoveryContext: parsed.recoveryContext,
606: 			reason: scheduled
607: 				? "recovery scheduled after cost budget exceeded"
608: 				: reason,
609: 		};
610: 	}
611: 	if (toolCallCount > env.AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS) {
612: 		const reason = `run exceeded the ${env.AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS} tool-call budget (${toolCallCount})`;
613: 		const scheduled = await maybeScheduleRecovery(parsed, {
614: 			code: "EXECUTION_TOOL_BUDGET_EXCEEDED",
615: 			reason,
616: 		});
617: 		return {
618: 			workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
619: 			executionId: parsed.executionId,
620: 			status: "skipped",
621: 			mode,
622: 			recoveryContext: parsed.recoveryContext,
623: 			reason: scheduled
624: 				? "recovery scheduled after tool-call budget exceeded"
625: 				: reason,
626: 		};
627: 	}
628: 	return {
629: 		workflowId: parsed.workflowId,
630: 		executionId: parsed.executionId,
631: 		status: "running",
632: 		mode,
633: 		recoveryContext: parsed.recoveryContext,
634: 		result,
635: 	};
636: }

- Re-home legacy schedule, webhook, recovery, and event features onto the new 17-table schema (runs, run_activities, chat_messages, approvals, notifications): rewrite the Inngest runner (execution-run → thread-runner), schedule-tick, notification-notifier, webhook route, and schedule-create capability; delete legacy WorkflowService + repositories + schemas; wire up untracked `schedules`/`webhook_hooks` tables.
- Commit the sweep (commit 8), including currently-untracked migration 0004 + schedules/webhook_hooks schema files.

## Important Details
- Repo root: `D:\github-desktop\aevryn` (monorepo: packages/db, packages/workflow, packages/inngest, packages/agent, packages/env, apps/web, packages/api).
- Design source of truth: `final-docs/SCHEDULE-WEBHOOK-REHOMING.md` (approved); running rule: keep MVP scope, never resurrect tables SCHEMA.md folded elsewhere; put dropped features into `run_activities`/`runs`.
- New schema facts: `runs` has `promptSnapshot`, `trigger(message|schedule|resume|approval|rerun)`, `threadId`, `workflowId`, `userId`; no `startedAt` (use `createdAt`); `costUsd` is text (parse Number()). `notifications` has NO channel/deliveredAt; type enum = system|workflow|run|security|webhook. Workflows have NO `objective`, NO `draft` status (statuses: waiting, planning, running, awaiting_approval, idle, paused, failed, completed).
- Key decisions made:
  - Recovery bookkeeping → `run_activities` system rows, stepLabel `recovery`, detail{attempt,failureClass,failureCode,strategy,result}; dedupe via `detail->>'attempt'`.
  - Sleep → `run_activities` stepLabel `sleep`, detail{sleepUntil: ISO}; schedule-tick wakes SAME run (trigger=resume, no new run row).
  - Notification webhook delivery idempotency (no deliveredAt column) → run_activities system row `stepLabel="notification.delivered"` detail{notificationId}; `notification/publish` event extended with optional `runId`.
  - Planning mode decision: thread.boundWorkflowId with NO plan → planning; else run (replaces legacy draft check).
  - Conversation context built from `chat_messages` (AI SDK UI Message shape, content jsonb `parts[].text`).
  - Webhook `consume_payload` persists `{ instruction }` at mint; consume merges `{ instruction, payload }`; resume prompt = instruction + payload excerpt. Token = base64url random, only SHA-256 hash stored.
  - `schedules` per-thread, unique (workspace_id, thread_id), `sched_` ULID, ids.schedule(); webhook hooks `whk_` ULID, ids.webhookHook(), run_id NOT unique.
  - withExecutionCapabilities signature will change to `(registry, context: { workflowId, threadId, workspaceId, userId })`.
- Env (packages/env/src/server.ts): EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS=900, EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD=1, AGENT_MAX_STEPS=5, AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS=50, RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=2, WEBHOOK_BASE_URL default http://localhost:3000, GROQ_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-20b, MEM0_API_KEY, INNGEST_EVENT_KEY/SIGNING_KEY/APP_ID.
- Ignore stale LSP errors referencing `packages/api/src/routers/agent.ts` + `context.ts` — those files are already deleted; only `packages/api/src/http.ts` + `index.ts` exist.
- Untracked files to include in commit: `packages/db/src/migrations/0004_lowly_ronan.sql`, `packages/db/src/migrations/meta/0004_snapshot.json`, `packages/db/src/schema/schedule.ts`, `packages/db/src/schema/webhook-hook.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260911150000_schedule_webhook_hooks.sql`.

## Work State
### Completed
- DB wiring: `packages/db/src/schema/index.ts` now exports `./schedule` + `./webhook-hook`; `ids.ts` has `schedule:"sched_"` + `webhookHook:"whk_"` and `ids.schedule()`/`ids.webhookHook()`; `relations.ts` has `scheduleRelations`, `webhookHookRelations`, plus `schedules`/`webhookHooks` many() on threadRelations and `webhookHooks` many() on runRelations.
- `RunService` (packages/workflow/src/services/run-service.ts) additions: `import sql`; `updateActivityDetail`, `sleepUntil(runId, sleepUntil, reason)`, `resumeTriggeredBy(runId)` (sleeping/waiting/awaiting_approval → pending), `listSleepingDue(now)`, `listReplayableToolOutputs(runId)` (type=tool status=complete, keyed by stepLabel, first output wins), `recordRecoveryAttempt` (idempotent), `countRecoveryAttempts`, `updateRecoveryResult`.
- `NotificationService.findById` added.
- New `packages/workflow/src/services/schedule-service.ts`: `ScheduleService` with upsert (onConflictDoUpdate unique(workspace_id, thread_id)), findById, listByThread, listByWorkspace, listDue(enabled+nextRunAt<=now), setEnabled, markRan(id, nextRunAt, lastRunId), delete.
- New `packages/workflow/src/services/webhook-hook-service.ts`: `WebhookHookService.mint` (stores consumePayload `{instruction}`, 30-day default expiry) + `consume` (hash lookup, already-fired/expired guards, marks fired + sets `consume_payload={instruction,payload}`); exports `webhookFireSchema` (z.unknown() non-empty refine).
- `packages/workflow/src/index.ts` rewritten: exports memory, recovery, schedule-utils, all NEW services (approval, key, member, memory, notification, plan, run, schedule, thread, webhook-hook) + types; legacy exports removed.
- `packages/inngest/src/events.ts` rewritten: `threadRunEvent="thread/run"` + `threadRunEventSchema` (runId, threadId, prompt(max 2000), modelContextCapChars, recoveryContext, approvedToolNames) + `ThreadRunEventData`; `notificationPublishEvent` + schema `{notificationId, runId?}` + `NotificationPublishEventData`; `threadRunResultSchema` + `ThreadRunResult` (statuses: completed/skipped/failed/sleeping/waiting/cancelled/awaiting_approval).

### Active
- Just finished WebhookHookService mint storing `consumePayload` instruction — todo queue expectation: next is creating inngest helpers/ + `thread-runner.ts` (the large port), then schedule-tick, notification-notifier, webhook route, schedule-create capability + registry change, deletions, exports, UI fixes, tsc/lint, commit.
- Todo list in agent state (in_progress/statuses): db wiring done; RunService additions done; NotificationService.findById done; ScheduleService + WebhookHookService done; workflow index done; events.ts done; remaining = helpers+thread-runner, schedule-tick, notification-notifier, webhook route, schedule-create capability, delete legacy files, index/import verification, ui fixes, tsc+lint, commit.

### Blocked
- None. Known non-blockers: stale LSP diagnostics for deleted `packages/api/src/routers/agent.ts`/`context.ts` and legacy `workflow-service.ts` (being deleted); `sql` unused-import diagnostic in run-service.ts was expected and resolved by added methods.

## Next Move
1. Write `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts` (+ `packages/inngest/src/helpers/`: prompts, memory, recovery orchestration) — port `execution-run.ts` logic onto new tables: idempotent gate (skip terminal/sleeping/waiting/awaiting_approval; pass running/pending), planning vs run mode (bound workflow without plan → planning), chat_messages-based conversation context, activity accumulator (tool-start → type=tool active, tool-end → update status + updateActivityDetail output, step-end → type=thinking), recovery loop using `RunService.recordRecoveryAttempt`/`countRecoveryAttempts`/`listReplayableToolOutputs` + re-enqueue SAME runId, sleep via `sleepUntil`, wait via `WebhookHookService.mint` + status waiting + notification, approvals via `ApprovalService.create` + status awaiting_approval, notify → `NotificationService.create` + send `notification/publish {notificationId, runId}`, usage via `recordUsage`; use `MemoryService` (resolve Mem0 key via KeyService) instead of raw Mem0MemoryStore.
2. Rewrite `packages/inngest/src/functions/schedule-tick.ts`: listDue schedules → create run (trigger=schedule, workflowId=thread.boundWorkflowId, promptSnapshot{cron/prompt config}) → send thread/run → markRan(scheduleId, nextRunAt, runId) → notification "Scheduled run started" (type=run); wake sleeping runs via listSleepingDue → resumeTriggeredBy → send thread/run (trigger=resume, prompt from run.promptSnapshot or thread.title).
3. Rewrite `notification-notifier.ts`: NotificationService.findById; type!==webhook → delivered; else parse body.url, POST, guard/write run_activities `notification.delivered` marker.
4. Rewrite `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts`: consume → run gate (sleeping/waiting) → resumeTriggeredBy → create system activity `webhook.resume` (detail{payload, webhookId, instruction}) → send thread/run (trigger=resume).
5. Rewrite `packages/agent/src/capabilities/schedule-create.ts` (thread-scoped ScheduleService.upsert) + update `packages/agent/src/registry.ts` `withExecutionCapabilities` to pass `{workflowId, threadId, workspaceId, userId}`; keep memory-store/memory-search as `(userId, workflowId)`.
6. Delete: `packages/inngest/src/functions/execution-run.ts`, `packages/workflow/src/services/workflow-service.ts`, `packages/workflow/src/repositories/` (12 files), `packages/workflow/src/schemas.ts`, `packages/workflow/src/errors.ts`; update `packages/inngest/src/index.ts` exports.
7. Fix UI tsc errors (ExecutionStatus → RunStatus; referenced earlier in nav-data.ts + sidebar-menu.tsx), run turbo `check-types` + lint, verify `packages/workflow` legacy-import sweep (only execution-run/ticks/notifier/route/capabilities touched it), commit all incl. untracked db migration/schema files.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/db/src/schema/index.ts`, `relations.ts`, `ids.ts`: wiring done for schedules/webhook_hooks.
- `packages/workflow/src/services/run-service.ts`: expanded (sleep/recovery/replay helpers).
- `packages/workflow/src/services/notification-service.ts`: added findById.
- `packages/workflow/src/services/schedule-service.ts`: NEW (ScheduleService).
- `packages/workflow/src/services/webhook-hook-service.ts`: NEW (WebhookHookService + webhookFireSchema).
- `packages/workflow/src/index.ts`: new export set.
- `packages/inngest/src/events.ts`: thread/run + notification/publish events.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/execution-run.ts`: legacy port source (read fully; `extractPlan`/`extractDecision` use fenced ```json blocks, planSchema/decisionSchema now removed from exports — reimplement zod locally or inline in runner), TO DELETE after rewrite.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/schedule-tick.ts`, `notification-notifier.ts`: legacy, TO REWRITE.
- `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts`: legacy route (imports executionRunEvent + WorkflowService + webhookFireSchema), TO REWRITE.
- `packages/agent/src/capabilities/schedule-create.ts`, `packages/agent/src/registry.ts`: TO REWRITE (context change).
- `packages/agent/src/capabilities/memory-store.ts` / `memory-search.ts`: keep `(userId, workflowId)` signatures.
- `packages/workflow/src/memory/mem0-store.ts`, `types.ts`, `recovery.ts` (classifyFailure), `schedule-utils.ts` (computeNextRun): retained/used.
- `packages/db/src/schema/schedule.ts`, `webhook-hook.ts`; `packages/db/src/migrations/0004_lowly_ronan.sql` + `meta/0004_snapshot.json`; `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260911150000_schedule_webhook_hooks.sql`: untracked, must be committed.
- `final-docs/SCHEDULE-WEBHOOK-REHOMING.md`: design spec.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

116: const TOOL_SELECTION_INSTRUCTIONS = `You are Aevryn, a web agent executing a user objective. You decide which capabilities to use; each selection is executed for you and the result is returned to you.

118: Tool selection policy — always use the cheapest capability that fulfills the objective:

If the objective needs a capability you do NOT have (schedules, sending email/Slack/Discord/webhooks, push notifications, storing files), state plainly that it is unavailable and complete the achievable part with tools instead.

152: export async function runAgent(
153: 	options: AgentRuntimeOptions,
154: ): Promise<AgentResult> {

161: 	const replayTool = (toolName: string): CapabilityResult | null => {
162: 		if (!(toolName in replay)) {
163: 			return null;
164: 		}
165: 		const output = replay[toolName];
166: 		delete replay[toolName];
167: 		return {
168: 			ok: true,
169: 			data: output,
170: 			provider: { id: "replay", operation: "persisted", durationMs: 0 },

201: 						record.completedAt = now();
202: 						record.status = "completed";
203: 						record.output = data;
204: 						record.provider = {
205: 							id: "replay",

207: 							durationMs: elapsedMs,
208: 						};

222: 						record.status = "failed";

224: 							code: result.error.code,
225: 							message: result.error.message,
226: 						};
227: 						record.provider = result.provider ?? {
228: 							id: capability.name,
229: 							durationMs: elapsedMs,
230: 						};
231: 						await emit({
232: 							type: "tool-end",
233: 							tool: capability.name,
234: 							status: "failed",
235: 						});
236: 						throw new Error(`${result.error.code}: ${result.error.message}`);
237: 					}
238: 					record.status = "completed";
239: 					record.output = result.data;
240: 					record.provider = result.provider ?? {
241: 						id: capability.name,
242: 						durationMs: elapsedMs,
243: 					};
244: 					await emit({
245: 						type: "tool-end",
246: 						tool: capability.name,
247: 						status: "completed",
248: 					});

348: function createActivityAccumulator(workflowId: string, executionId: string) {
349: 	const snapshot: ActivitySnapshot = {
350: 		status: "running",
351: 		currentActivity: "starting",
352: 		executionId,
353: 		steps: [],
354: 		tools: [],
355: 		updatedAt: new Date(),
356: 	};
357: 	let toolCounter = 0;
358: 	const persistTool = (
359: 		activity: Extract<
360: 			AgentActivity,
361: 			{ type: "tool-start" } | { type: "tool-end" }
362: 		>,
363: 		order: number,
364: 	) =>
365: 		workflowService.upsertToolActivity({
366: 			workflowId,
367: 			executionId,
368: 			order,
369: 			tool: activity.tool,
370: 			status: activity.type === "tool-start" ? "called" : activity.status,
371: 			input:
372: 				activity.type === "tool-start"
373: 					? (activity.input as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)
374: 					: undefined,
375: 		});
376: 	return {
377: 		apply(activity: AgentActivity): void {
378: 			snapshot.updatedAt = new Date();
379: 			switch (activity.type) {
380: 				case "tool-start": {
381: 					const order = toolCounter++;
382: 					void persistTool(activity, order).catch(() => {});
383: 					snapshot.tools.push({
384: 						order,
385: 						step: snapshot.steps.length,
386: 						tool: activity.tool,
387: 						status: "running",
388: 					});
389: 					snapshot.currentActivity = `running ${activity.tool}`;
390: 					break;
391: 				}
392: 				case "tool-end": {
393: 					const entry = snapshot.tools.find(
394: 						(t) => t.tool === activity.tool && t.status === "running",
395: 					);
396: 					if (entry) {
397: 						entry.status = activity.status;
398: 						void persistTool(activity, entry.order).catch(() => {});
399: 					}
400: 					snapshot.currentActivity = undefined;
401: 					break;
402: 				}
403: 				case "step-end": {
404: 					snapshot.steps = snapshot.steps.filter(
405: 						(s) => s.order !== activity.step,
406: 					);
407: 					snapshot.steps.push({
408: 						order: activity.step,
409: 						text: activity.text,
410: 					});
411: 					snapshot.steps.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
412: 					snapshot.currentActivity = "summarizing";
413: 					break;
414: 				}
415: 			}
416: 		},
417: 		snapshot() {
418: 			return {
419: 				...snapshot,
420: 				steps: [...snapshot.steps],
421: 				tools: [...snapshot.tools],
422: 			};
423: 		},
424: 	};

11: 		data: z.object({

13: 		}),

17: export async function publishNotification(data: unknown): Promise<{
18: 	notificationId: string;
19: 	outcome: "delivered" | "skipped" | "not-found";
20: }> {
21: 	const result = publishEventSchema.safeParse(data).success
22: 		? publishEventSchema.parse(data).event.data
23: 		: null;
24: 	if (!result) {
25: 		return { notificationId: "unknown", outcome: "skipped" };
26: 	}
27: 	const { notificationId } = result;
28: 
29: 	const notification = await workflowService.getNotification(notificationId);
30: 	if (!notification) {
31: 		return { notificationId, outcome: "not-found" };
32: 	}
33: 	if (notification.deliveredAt) {
34: 		return { notificationId, outcome: "delivered" };
35: 	}
36: 	if (notification.channel !== "webhook") {
37: 		return { notificationId, outcome: "skipped" };
38: 	}
39: 	const url = notification.body?.url;
40: 	if (typeof url !== "string" || !/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
41: 		return { notificationId, outcome: "skipped" };
42: 	}
43: 	try {
44: 		const response = await fetch(url, {
45: 			method: "POST",
46: 			headers: {
47: 				"content-type": "application/json",
48: 			},

53: 				workflowId: notification.workflowId,
54: 				sentAt: new Date().toISOString(),
55: 				baseUrl: env.WEBHOOK_BASE_URL,
56: 			}),
57: 			signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
58: 		});
59: 		if (!response.ok) {

61: 		}
62: 		await workflowService.markNotificationDelivered(notificationId);
63: 		return { notificationId, outcome: "delivered" };
64: 	} catch {
65: 		// Leave deliveredAt unset; the next publish attempt retries the POST.
66: 		return { notificationId, outcome: "skipped" };
67: 	}

content.text:
## Objective
- Re-home legacy schedule, webhook, recovery, and event features onto the new 17-table schema: rewrite the Inngest runner (execution-run → thread-runner), schedule-tick, notification-notifier, webhook route, and schedule-create capability; delete legacy WorkflowService + repositories + schemas; wire up previously-untracked `schedules`/`webhook_hooks` tables; commit the full sweep (commit 8).

## Important Details
- Repo root: `D:\github-desktop\aevryn` (monorepo: packages/db, workflow, inngest, agent, env; apps/web, packages/api).
- Design source of truth: `final-docs/SCHEDULE-WEBHOOK-REHOMING.md`; running rules: MVP scope, never resurrect folded tables, dropped features live in `run_activities`/`runs`.
- New schema facts: `runs` has `promptSnapshot`, `trigger(message|schedule|resume|approval|rerun)`, `threadId`, `workflowId`, `userId`, NO `startedAt`/`workspaceId` (use `createdAt`/thread.workspaceId). `notifications` NO channel/deliveredAt; type enum = system|workflow|run|security|webhook; body = string (JSON text). Workflows NO objective/draft status.
- Planning mode DROPPED for MVP: runner always run-mode (default registry + decisions), no plan extraction/creation/planProgress-on-plans. `planProgress` decision field persisted as run_activities system row `stepLabel="plan.progress"`.
- Recovery bookkeeping → run_activities `stepLabel="recovery"` detail{attempt,failureClass,failureCode,strategy,result}; dedupe via detail->>'attempt'. Sleep → supported; wake via schedule-tick, SAME run (`runService.resumeTriggeredBy`, trigger=resume, no new row).
- Webhook delivery idempotency (no deliveredAt col) → run_activities `stepLabel="notification.delivered"` detail{notificationId}; `notification/publish` carries optional runId. Notifier: non-webhook type → "delivered" skip; webhook POST to body.url.
- Webhook resume: mint stores consumePayload{instruction}; consume merges {instruction,payload}; route prompt = instruction + payload excerpt (≤2000); system activity `webhook.resume`; token = base64url, SHA-256 hash stored; hook single-use via fired status.
- `schedules` per-thread, unique (workspace_id, thread_id), `sched_`/ids.schedule(); webhook hooks `whk_`/ids.webhookHook(), run_id NOT unique.
- `withExecutionCapabilities(registry, { workflowId?, threadId, workspaceId, userId })`; memory-store/search stay `(userId, workflowId)`.
- Decision schema reimplemented locally (`packages/inngest/src/functions/helpers/decisions.ts`, strict zod): action complete|sleep|notify|stop|wait; sleepUntil coerced date; waitFor{description, expiresInSeconds(60..2592000)}; notification{type, channel in-app|webhook default in-app, subject, body}; planProgress{currentStep, status}.
- Env: EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS=900, EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD=1, AGENT_MAX_STEPS=5, AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS=50, RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=2, WEBHOOK_BASE_URL default http://localhost:3000, GROQ_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-20b.
- Ignore stale LSP errors for deleted `packages/api/src/routers/agent.ts`/`context.ts` and legacy `workflow-service.ts` (files already deleted), plus legacy-notification/workflow status references in them.
- Untracked files to commit: `packages/db/src/migrations/0004_lowly_ronan.sql`, `packages/db/src/migrations/meta/0004_snapshot.json`, `packages/db/src/schema/schedule.ts`, `packages/db/src/schema/webhook-hook.ts`, `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260911150000_schedule_webhook_hooks.sql`.

## Work State
### Completed
- DB wiring done: schema/index.ts exports schedule + webhook-hook; ids.ts `schedule:"sched_"`/`webhookHook:"whk_"`; relations for schedules/webhook_hooks + threadRelations/runRelations many().
- RunService additions: updateActivityDetail, sleepUntil, resumeTriggeredBy (sleeping/waiting/awaiting_approval → pending), listSleepingDue, listReplayableToolOutputs (type=tool complete, keyed by stepLabel), recordRecoveryAttempt (idempotent), countRecoveryAttempts, updateRecoveryResult.
- ScheduleService (upsert onConflictDoUpdate, listDue, setEnabled, markRan, delete), WebhookHookService (mint/consume, webhookFireSchema), NotificationService.findById, ThreadService.listMessagesByThread(threadId, limit=200), workflow index rewritten (legacy exports removed, all new services).
- events.ts rewritten: threadRunEvent "thread/run" + threadRunEventSchema (runId, threadId, prompt≤2000, modelContextCapChars?, recoveryContext?, approvedToolNames?), notificationPublishEvent + `{notificationId, runId?}`, threadRunResultSchema + ThreadRunResult.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/helpers/prompts.ts` (RUN_DECISION_INSTRUCTIONS, RECOVERY_HINTS per failure code, recoveryBlock, buildRunInstructions) — healthy, no LSP errors.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/helpers/memory.ts` — MemoryService retriever (preferProcedural), storeEpisodicMemory, storeProceduralMemory, getConversationContext (ThreadService.listMessagesByThread; user/assistant turns; extracts `parts[].text`; omits tool/system; keeps newest) — clean.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/helpers/decisions.ts` — decisionSchema, Decision, extractDecision (fenced ```json block) — clean.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts` — written (executeThreadRun = runAgentStep + persistAndCompleteStep), env import added, thread fetched before budgets, workspaceId via thread; only remaining pre-registry error: withExecutionCapabilities expected 3 args (fixed by registry edit below).
- `packages/agent/src/registry.ts` — withExecutionCapabilities rewritten to object-context signature (schedules + memory registered).
- `packages/agent/src/capabilities/schedule-create.ts` — rewritten thread-scoped (ScheduleService.upsert with workspaceId/threadId/userId, superRefine cron-or-interval) — clean.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/schedule-tick.ts` — rewritten (listDue + listSleepingDue; fire-schedule: run create trigger=schedule + thread/run + markRan via computeNextRun + "Scheduled run started" type=run notification; wake-sleeping: resumeTriggeredBy + thread/run; NonRetriableError import cleaned) — clean.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/notification-notifier.ts` — rewritten (hasMarkedDelivered via run_activities system rows stepLabel "notification.delivered"; POST with aevryn:notification envelope + WEBHOOK_BASE_URL; markDelivered) — clean.
- `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts` — rewritten (consume → run/thread gate → resumeTriggeredBy → webhook.resume activity → thread/run → 200 accepted; error codes INVALID_PAYLOAD/WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND/WEBHOOK_RUN_NOT_FOUND/WEBHOOK_THREAD_NOT_FOUND/RESUME_SCHEDULE_FAILED) — clean.
- `packages/workflow/src/services/webhook-hook-service.ts` mint updated: consumePayload stores `{ instruction }`.

### Active
- Inngest functions/index export wiring + legacy deletion not yet applied (inngest/src/index.ts still exports execution-run; execution-run.ts still on disk).

### Blocked
- None. Only remaining known error is gone (withExecutionCapabilities call resolved by registry edit); stale LSP diagnostics are for already-deleted files.

## Next Move
1. Update `packages/inngest/src/index.ts` to export `./functions/schedule-tick`, `./functions/notification-notifier`, `./functions/thread-runner` (drop execution-run); delete `packages/inngest/src/functions/execution-run.ts`, `packages/workflow/src/services/workflow-service.ts`, `packages/workflow/src/repositories/` (12 files), `packages/workflow/src/schemas.ts`, `packages/workflow/src/errors.ts`.
2. Grep remaining legacy imports (`signInWithPassword`/executionRunEvent/schemas.ts/execution-run/WorkflowService/Mem0MemoryStore) across packages/inngest, packages/workflow, apps/web, packages/api; fix any stragglers (e.g. client.ts, webhook test page, client-side webhook POST).
3. Fix UI tsc errors (ExecutionStatus → RunStatus in apps/web/src/lib/nav-data.ts + sidebar-menu.tsx; check settings-billing-history/usage-table useSWR → @tanstack/react-query).
4. Run turbo `check-types` + lint (verify packages/workflow + inngest typecheck clean), then `git add -A && git status && git commit` (include untracked migration 0004 + schema files) and `git push`.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts`: NEW core runner (decisions-only; skip gate; recovery; sleep/wait/notify/stop/complete; memory; approvals).
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/helpers/{prompts,memory,decisions}.ts`: NEW.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/schedule-tick.ts`, `notification-notifier.ts`: rewritten.
- `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts`: rewritten.
- `packages/agent/src/registry.ts` + `packages/agent/src/capabilities/schedule-create.ts`: rewritten (thread context).

# Design: Schedule, Webhook, Recovery & Events Re-homing (commit 8)

Decision record for re-homing the 4 features the new 17-table schema dropped.
User-approved (2026-09-11). Guiding rule: **keep docs MVP scope; ADD missing
required features; never resurrect tables the SCHEMA.md folded elsewhere.**

## 1. Schedules — NEW table `schedules`

- **Why**: `createSchedule` capability + recurring monitors ("check every X")
  need a recurrence config the docs left implicit (`PG/SCHEDULE.md` only had
  `runs.trigger=schedule` + `runs.status=sleeping` + Inngest cron). Without a
  table, per-workflow recurrence config is impossible.
- **Table**: ports legacy `schedule` shape onto the new FK set —
  `sched_` ULID, `workspace_id`, `thread_id`, `user_id`, `cron`, `interval_seconds`,
  `next_run_at`, `last_run_at`, `last_run_id`, `enabled`, `config` jsonb,
  `created_at/updated_at`. Unique `(workspace_id, thread_id)`.
- **tick**: `schedule-tick` keeps its real Inngest cron trigger; body =
  scan `enabled + next_run_at <= now()` → fire `thread/run` (trigger=schedule,
  run_id saved to `schedules.last_run_id`) → advance `next_run_at`. Wakes
  `runs.status=sleeping` due too.
- RLS: owner OR workspace member (same as runs).

## 2. Durable webhooks — NEW table `webhook_hooks`

- **Why**: user wants the "run pauses until CI/webhook pings" flow kept
  (SCHEMA.md §17 had retired `webhook-board`/`waitForWebhook` from MVP). Keep it
  as a required feature scoped to runs (not workflows).
- **Table**: `whk_` ULID, `run_id` (ref runs), `workspace_id`, `thread_id`,
  `user_id`, `token_hash` (unique — WebCrypto SHA-256 of raw token; never raw),
  `status`(active|fired|expired), `expires_at`, `fired_at`, `consume_payload`
  jsonb (what the POST body resumes), `created_at`. `run_id` NOT unique —
  one run can mint several hooks.
- **Route** `POST /api/v1/hooks/[token]`: `WebhookHookService` consumes by
  token (hash → row), status active → set fired, then `runs` gateway change
  (sleeping/waiting → resume via inngest `thread/run` trigger=resume) + append
  payload to that run's `run_activities` (type=system).
- same Auth: none (token IS the secret). Expire check inside service.
- Kill: `webhookBoard` absence is fine — new table replaces legacy `webhook_board`.

## 3. Recovery attempts — NO table; folded into `run_activities`

- AUDIT praises bounded recovery (`recordRecoveryAttempt` boolean gate,
  `classifyFailure`, `RECOVERY_HINTS`). SCHEMA.md dropped `recovery_attempt`.
- **Home**: `run_activities` rows `type=system`, `step_label="recovery"`,
  `detail={attempt, failureClass, failureCode, strategy, result}`.
- Classifier (`classifyFailure`/`FailureClassification`, `RECOVERY_HINTS`) stays
  in pure module (`packages/agent/src/recovery.ts`) — no DB of its own.
- Bounded: `RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (server cap) enforced by runner per run;
  recovery attempt consult = count system/recovery activities on that run.

## 4. Events + observations — NO tables; absorbed in `run_activities`

- diff: old `event` = flat appened milestones (flow start/end/status), old
  `observation` = agent evidence (type+jsonb), old `agent_state` = god jsonb
  (plan+progress+activity snapshot). SCHEMA.md §10 already replaces all three.
- Milestone → `type=system`; observation → `type=system` + `detail`;
  plan/progress → `plans`/`plan_steps`; activity snapshot → the rows themselves.
- **Chosen**: run_activities wins (typed, realtime, RLS, drives ThinkingSteps).
  Do NOT resurrect event/observation/agent_state.

# ENV — Variables & User-Suppliable Keys

Three layers: **server/infra env** (Vercel/Next server, never client),
**user workspace keys** (entered by user in Workflow Settings → Agent/Env tab,
stored in DB, encrypted), and **per-thread overrides** (rare, optional).

## Existing env (old backend → what to keep)

| Var | Used by (old) | New use |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` / `DIRECT_URL` | drizzle pg | → Supabase project connection string (keep, used by drizzle) |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` / `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | better-auth | **DELETE** (Supabase Auth owns sessions) |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | unused today | keep — supabase-js client |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` | unused today | keep — anon role for RLS/DATA API |
| `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` | — | **ADD** server-only, storage uploads + admin (never NEXT_PUBLIC) |
| `ANAKIN_API_KEY` / `ANAKIN_BASE_URL` | agent adapters | fallback default; user can override per workspace |
| `GROQ_API_KEY` / `GROQ_MODEL` | runtime | fallback defaults; per workspace override |
| `MEM0_API_KEY` | workflow mem0 | fallback; per workspace override |
| `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` / `SIGNING_KEY` / `APP_ID` | inngest client | keep |
| `WEBHOOK_BASE_URL` | webhook-board | keep |
| `AGENT_MAX_STEPS` / `AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS` / `EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS` / `EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD` / `EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS` / `RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | inngest | keep as server caps (hard ceiling) |

## NEW env (definitive list, final)

```
# --- Supabase ---
DATABASE_URL                # postgres connection for drizzle (direct)
DIRECT_URL                  # pooler direct url (non-pooled, for migrations)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL    # client
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY  # client anon (never secret)
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY   # server only — storage bucket mgmt, user creation
SUPABASE_AUTH_SECRET        # optional: for verifying webhook JWT from auth hooks

# --- Inngest ---
INNGEST_EVENT_KEY
INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY
INNGEST_APP_ID

# --- Webhook interop ---
WEBHOOK_BASE_URL            # base url for generated /api/v1/hooks/:token urls

# --- Defaults (single fallback key each; user overrides per-workspace in UI) ---
ANAKIN_API_KEY
ANAKIN_BASE_URL             # default https://api.anakin.io/v1
GROQ_API_KEY
GROQ_MODEL                  # default text model, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-20b
MEM0_API_KEY

# --- Server hard caps (clamp user values; not editable by user) ---
AGENT_MAX_STEPS             # default 5      — ceiling
AGENT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS        # default 50     — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_SECONDS       # default 900    — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_COST_USD      # default 1      — ceiling
EXECUTION_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS # default 604800 — ceiling
RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS       # default 2      — ceiling

# --- Model routing (per category; fall back from workspace → env default) ---
TEXT_MODEL                   # alias of GROQ_MODEL default (kept by name parity)
IMAGE_MODEL                  # default e.g. groq/text2img or provider, optional
SPEECH_MODEL                 # optional
TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL          # optional
VIDEO_MODEL                  # optional (future)
```

> Client (`packages/env/src/web.ts`) must expose only:
> `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`.
> Everything else stays server-only. `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION` respected.

## Where the USER enters their own keys (UI)

Primary → **Workflow Settings dialog → "Agent" tab** (rename of
"Instructions"), with an **"Environment"** subsection:

- Groq API key + Groq model (text)
- Anakin API key + base URL
- Mem0 API key
- (secondary) Image / Speech / Transcription / Video model overrides

Stored in DB table `workspace_api_keys`:
`workspace_id | user_id | provider | key_name | key_value(encrypted) | created_at`.

- **"Success, no rows returned"** is normal. DDL (`CREATE TABLE/`TYPE`/`TRIGGER`) never returns rows; success = applied.
- **"Already exists" errors on re-run = expected.** Those two files create the *same* objects. `20260911150000_schedule_webhook_hooks.sql` (supabase) and `0004_lowly_ronan.sql` (drizzle mirror) both create `schedules`, `webhook_hooks`, and the `hook_status` enum. 50: 	}

60: 			.returning();

70: 			.set({ status })

72: 			.returning();
73: 		return row;
74: 	}
75:

77: 		const plan = await this.getByWorkflow(workflowId);

80: 		}
81: 		return this.setStatus(plan.id, "accepted");
82: 	}

111: 				.from(planSteps)
112: 				.where(eq(planSteps.planId, input.planId));
113: 			const nextPosition = input.position ?? (maxRow[0]?.value ?? -1) + 1;
114: 			const [row] = await tx
115: 				.insert(planSteps)
116: 				.values({
117: 					id: ids.planStep(),

119: 					position: nextPosition,
120: 					title: input.title,
121: 					description: input.description ?? null,
122: 					status: "pending",
123: 				})

150: 	}

153: 		await this.scope().transaction(async (tx) => {
154: 			for (const [index, stepId] of orderedStepIds.entries()) {

159: 			}

## Objective
- Answer delivered: cloud DB already fully migrated — no migration run needed before P5; only gap = `on_auth_user_created` trigger on `auth.users` (missing).
- Now actively building P5: `POST /api/chat` streaming route + live AI SDK tools. User approved build ("yes"), compaction happened, user asked "what's next" → assistant started P5 implementation.

## Important Details
- **Corrected (overrides prior assumption):** migrations were verified already-applied on cloud via live query; nothing to run. User then re-ran `20260911150000_schedule_webhook_hooks.sql` + `0004_lowly_ronan.sql`; "success, no rows returned" = normal; "already exists" errors on re-run = expected (same objects in both files), harmless. User told: never re-run migration files; never run `db:migrate`/`db:push` against cloud (no drizzle history; `0000` = legacy snapshot).
- Live cloud DB state (project `mndzexcqfubygquimkmn`, verified via `DATABASE_URL`): all 17 tables + `schedules` + `webhook_hooks`; enums incl. `hook_status`; RLS on all tables (`schedules`=4, `webhook_hooks`=4); storage bucket `chat-attachments`; realtime publication = chat_messages, run_activities, approval_requests, notifications, schedules, webhook_hooks; triggers = enforce_thread_limit→threads, enforce_group_limit→groups, prevent_system_group_delete→groups; function `handle_new_user` exists but **trigger `on_auth_user_created` missing** (SQL fix block already pasted to user; affects new signups only).
- No `__drizzle_migrations` / `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` history tables — migrations were applied via SQL editor, not CLI. `supabase` CLI not installed.
- P5 scope (explained to user; user approved): `POST /api/chat` streaming via `streamText` (AI SDK v7) + standalone `toUIMessageStream` + `createUIMessageStreamResponse`; key resolution order = member override → workspace keys → env fallback (`GROQ_API_KEY`, `ANAKIN_API_KEY`); tools = listCapabilities, askQuestion, showPlan, editPlan, bindWorkflow, storeMemory, searchMemory, httpRequest, delegateAgenticWork (generateImage/transcribeAudio deferred); auto-approve; attachments; quality slider → maxOutputTokens; verify ARCHITECTURE §K scenarios 1–3.
- AI SDK v7 API facts (confirmed from `node_modules/ai/dist/index.d.ts`): `createUIMessageStreamResponse({status,statusText,headers,stream,consumeSseStream})` takes `ReadableStream<UIMessageChunk>`; standalone `toUIMessageStream({stream,tools,...})`; `result.toUIMessageStream*` deprecated; `streamText` result has `text/usage/steps/toolCalls` + `onFinish`; `streamText.messages` accepts UIMessage arrays. Bundled `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` lives in bun store: `node_modules/.bun/ai@7.0.93+ab3ed8e9421bfd7b/node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils`.
- Zod catalog = v4.5.4. AGENTS.md-style caution: check docs before library use; no vitest suite yet.
- Memory service types (`packages/workflow/src/memory/types.ts`): `MemoryCategory` = working|episodic|semantic|procedural; `StoreMemoryInput` = {userId,text,category?,workflowId?,executionId?,metadata?} and `SearchMemoryInput` = {userId,query,limit?,categories?,threshold?} — **no workspaceId/threadId fields**; `tools.ts` currently passes them → will need alignment (metadata or service change).
- `MESSAGE_STATUSES` = draft|queued|streaming|completed|failed|interrupted; `MESSAGE_ROLES` = user|assistant|system|tool (`packages/db/src/domain.ts`).
- Auth for route: `createServerSupabaseForNext()` (`apps/web/src/lib/supabase-server.ts` — reads `apps/web/.env`); `requireUser`/`getCurrentUser` from `@aevryn/auth` return `{id, email?}`.
- `@aevryn/db` exports: schema tables incl. `workflows`, `ids` (incl. `thread`/`chatMessage`/`runActivity`/`workflow`), `db`, domain, zod.
- `@aevryn/workflow` exports all services: run, thread, schedule, webhook-hook, notification, approval, plan, memory, key, member + mem0-store + recovery + types.
- PlanService methods confirmed: create, findById, getByWorkflow, update, setStatus, addStep, getPlanWithSteps, listSteps, updateStep, setStepStatus.
- `packages/agent` deps include `@aevryn/db`, `@aevryn/workflow`, `@anakin-io/sdk`, `ai` ^7.0.93, `zod`. `apps/web` has NO `ai` dep yet. Route will inject `onDelegateWork` (agent pkg cannot depend on `@aevryn/inngest`).
- Design decisions: chat persisted as `chatMessages.content = UIMessageParts` jsonb; assistant placeholder row status `streaming` → `completed`/`failed` on finish; tool activities recorded inside `act()` wrapper via `ctx.onToolActivity`; `delegateAgenticWork` = create run + send `threadRunEvent` via injected callback.
- Env: `GROQ_MODEL` default `openai/gpt-oss-20b` in `apps/web/.env`; `INNGEST_APP_ID` empty; legacy `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET/BETTER_AUTH_URL` to remove eventually.

## Work State
### Completed
- Told user: DB fully migrated; only `on_auth_user_created` trigger re-creation needed (full idempotent SQL given); explained "success/no rows" + "already exists" behavior; confirmed post-run state (schedules 13 cols, webhook_hooks 11 cols, hook_status, 8 policies, realtime) via live check.
- Explained P5 to user; user approved build.
- P5 recon: services, auth helpers, ids, env, AI SDK v7 signatures, memory types, thread-runner patterns.
- Wrote `packages/agent/src/chat/schemas.ts` (single-source `chatToolSchemas` const object with 9 schemas + `ChatToolName` + `CHAT_TOOL_NAMES`).
- Wrote `packages/agent/src/chat/prompt.ts` (`CHAT_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `ChatContext`, `buildChatSystemPrompt`).
- Wrote `packages/agent/src/chat/tools.ts` (`ChatToolServices`/`ChatToolActivity`/`ChatToolContext`, `formatPlan`, `createChatTools` with `act()` activity wrapper, all 9 `tool({...})` defs).
- Todo list created (recon done; schemas/prompt/tools in progress; route + deps pending; typecheck pending).

### Active
- Fixing LSP type errors in `packages/agent/src/chat/tools.ts`:
  - `import { z } from "zod"` unused (line 9) — remove.
  - "No overload matches this call … `ZodObject<{}, $strict>` not assignable to `FlexibleSchema<never>`" + "execute … not assignable to undefined" on every `tool({ inputSchema: chatToolSchemas.X })` call. Working hypothesis: schemas exposed via `as const` object break `ai` v7 `tool()` parameter inference; fix by exporting individual named schema consts (`listCapabilitiesSchema`, `askQuestionSchema`, …) from `schemas.ts` and importing them directly. Diagnostic confirmed `tool`/`FlexibleSchema` come from bundled `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` (bun store), not `node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils` (absent).
- Suspected further TS errors (not yet surfaced): `memory.store`/`memory.search` calls pass `workspaceId`/`threadId` not present in `StoreMemoryInput`/`SearchMemoryInput`.

### Blocked
- `tools.ts` type errors unresolved (in progress; not blocking). `supabase` CLI absent (trigger fix done via dashboard SQL editor instead). Pre-existing `@aevryn/ui` type-check failures unrelated (slider.tsx, use-merge-split.tsx, dotmatrix-core.tsx).

## Next Move
1. Fix `tools.ts`: remove unused `z` import; restructure `schemas.ts` to export each schema as a named const; import those into `tools.ts` so `tool()` infers parameters; run `cd packages/agent && bun run check-types` (tsc --noEmit).
2. Write `packages/agent/src/chat/stream.ts` (build UIMessages from stored ChatMessage rows; content = UIMessageParts) + `packages/agent/src/chat/index.ts` barrel; add `export * from "./chat"` to `packages/agent/src/index.ts`.
3. Write `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: `requireUser` auth → body zod parse → thread find/authorize (or create) → key/model resolve → run + user message + assistant placeholder persist → `createGroq`/`streamText` → `toUIMessageStream` + `createUIMessageStreamResponse` → `onFinish` persists assistant message + run status/usage; wire `onToolActivity` → `runService.createActivity`; add `ai`+`@ai-sdk/groq` to `apps/web/package.json`.
4. Typecheck web + agent; live-stream test (scenarios 1–3); report.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/agent/src/chat/schemas.ts`, `prompt.ts`, `tools.ts`: written; schemas needs restructure, tools needs error fix. `stream.ts`, `index.ts`: to create.
- `packages/agent/src/index.ts`: add chat export.
- `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: to create. `apps/web/package.json`: add `ai`/`@ai-sdk/groq`.
- `node_modules/.bun/ai@7.0.93+ab3ed8e9421bfd7b/node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils`: `tool`/`FlexibleSchema` source for overload diagnosis.
- `packages/workflow/src/memory/types.ts`: MemoryCategory + Store/SearchMemoryInput (no workspaceId/threadId).
- `packages/workflow/src/services/plan-service.ts`, `memory-service.ts`, `key-service.ts`, `run-service.ts`, `thread-service.ts`: service API surface for tools/route.
- `packages/auth/src/user.ts`, `server.ts`; `apps/web/src/lib/supabase-server.ts`: route auth helpers.
- `packages/db/src/domain.ts`: message/run statuses. `packages/db/src/index.ts`, `ids.ts`: db client, id prefixes.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts`, `helpers/{decisions,prompts,memory}.ts`: durable-run patterns to mimic for chat prompt/activities.
- `packages/db/supabase/migrations/20260911130000_supabase_glue.sql`: `handle_new_user` + trigger SQL already pasted to user (for dashboard SQL editor fix).
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

12: /**
13:  * User-scoped memory backend, resolved through the key vault.
14:  *
15:  * Every mem0 call is scoped to the exact user id, so memory can never leak
16:  * across users. A single store is cached per (workspaceId, userId) pair —
17:  * "ONE store per user" — and memories carry workflow/thread metadata so the
18:  * agent can scope recall to a chat thread. When no mem0 key is configured
19:  * (either in the vault or env), the backend degrades to a null store: saves
20:  * no-op, search returns nothing, so an undeployed memory integration never
21:  * breaks a run.
22:  */
23: export class MemoryService {
24: 	private readonly stores = new Map<string, Mem0MemoryStore>();
25: 
26: 	constructor(
27: 		private readonly client: Db = db,
28: 		private readonly keys = new KeyService(client),
29: 	) {}
30: 
31: 	private cacheKey(workspaceId: string, userId: string): string {
32: 		return `${workspaceId}:${userId}`;
33: 	}
34: 
35: 	private async storeFor(
36: 		workspaceId: string,
37: 		userId: string,
38: 	): Promise<Mem0MemoryStore> {
39: 		const key = this.cacheKey(workspaceId, userId);
40: 		let store = this.stores.get(key);
41: 		if (!store) {
42: 			const resolved = await this.keys.resolveKey(workspaceId, userId, "mem0");
43: 			store = new Mem0MemoryStore(resolved.key ?? "");
44: 			this.stores.set(key, store);
45: 		}
46: 		return store;
47: 	}
48: 
49: 	async resolveWorkspaceId(workflowId: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
50: 		const workflow = await this.client.query.workflows.findFirst({
51: 			where: eq(workflows.id, workflowId),
52: 			columns: { workspaceId: true },
53: 		});
54: 		return workflow?.workspaceId;
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	async store(
58: 		input: StoreMemoryInput & {
59: 			workspaceId?: string;
60: 			workflowId?: string;
61: 			threadId?: string;
62: 		},
63: 	): Promise<{ id: string }> {
64: 		const resolvedWorkspaceId =
65: 			input.workspaceId ??
66: 			(input.workflowId
67: 				? await this.resolveWorkspaceId(input.workflowId)
68: 				: undefined);
69: 		if (!resolvedWorkspaceId) {
70: 			return { id: "mem_offline" };
71: 		}
72: 		const store = await this.storeFor(resolvedWorkspaceId, input.userId);
73: 		return store.store({
74: 			userId: input.userId,
75: 			text: input.text,
76: 			category: input.category ?? "semantic",
77: 			workflowId: input.workflowId,
78: 			executionId: input.executionId,
79: 			metadata: {

98: 				: undefined);
99: 		if (!resolvedWorkspaceId) {
100: 			return [];
101: 		}
102: 		const store = await this.storeFor(resolvedWorkspaceId, input.userId);
103: 		const entries = await store.search({
