## Objective
- Building P5: `POST /api/chat` streaming route + live AI SDK tools (user approved). Cloud DB migration vert: nothing to run; only missing `on_auth_user_created` trigger (SQL already given).

## Important Details
- **`tools.ts` blocker resolved.** Root cause: repo TS = **6.0.3**; ai v7 `tool()` infer from its 4-way `Tool` union collapses to `FlexibleSchema<never>` under TS6. Verified failing: root zod v4, `zod/v3`, and `zodSchema()` wrapper (all without explicit type args). **Working pattern (proven in scratch, compiles clean):**
  ```ts
  tool<INPUT, OUTPUT, CONTEXT>({
    description: "…",
    inputSchema: zodSchema(schema),   // wrap plain zod schema
    execute: exec,
  })
  ```
  Rules: explicit generic args required (`INPUT` = `z.output<typeof schema>`, empty schemas = `Record<string, never>`); `CONTEXT` must extend `Record<string, unknown>` (provider-utils `Context` type) → `ChatToolContext` is now **type alias**, not interface; tool object has **NO `name` field** (v7 removed it; deprecated `title?` remains) — identity = key in tools map passed to `streamText({ tools: { myTool: tool } })`.
- **Zod copies present** (red herring for the fix, still relevant context): root zod = `4.5.4`; bundled `node_modules/.bun/@ai-sdk+provider-utils@5.0.39+ab3ed8e9421bfd7b/node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils` carries its own dep `zod@3.25.76`, peer `^3.25.76 || ^4.1.8`. Root zod v4 + `zodSchema()` + explicit generics works.
- AI SDK v7 facts (from `node_modules/ai/dist/index.d.ts`): `createUIMessageStreamResponse({status,statusText,headers,stream,consumeSseStream})` takes `ReadableStream<UIMessageChunk>`; standalone `toUIMessageStream({stream,tools,...})`; `streamText` result has `text/usage/steps/toolCalls/onFinish`; `streamText.messages` accepts UIMessage arrays.
- P5 scope: key resolution = member override → workspace keys → env fallback (`GROQ_API_KEY`, `ANAKIN_API_KEY`); tools = listCapabilities, askQuestion, showPlan, editPlan, bindWorkflow, storeMemory, searchMemory, httpRequest, delegateAgenticWork (generateImage/transcribeAudio deferred); auto-approve; attachments; quality slider → maxOutputTokens; verify ARCHITECTURE §K scenarios 1–3.
- `MESSAGE_ROLES` = user|assistant|system|tool; `MESSAGE_STATUSES` = draft|queued|streaming|completed|failed|interrupted (`packages/db/src/domain.ts`).
- Memory: `MemoryService.store/search` **DO accept** `workspaceId`/`threadId` (service-level input extends `StoreMemoryInput`/`SearchMemoryInput`; prior "no workspace/thread fields" concern void). `searchMemory.threadScope` maps to `threadId: ctx.threadId`.
- Design: chat persisted as `chatMessages.content = UIMessageParts` jsonb; assistant placeholder status `streaming` → `completed`/`failed`; tool activities via `ctx.onToolActivity` → `runService.createActivity`; `delegateAgenticWork` → `ctx.onDelegateWork` injected callback (agent pkg cannot import `@aevryn/inngest`).
- Auth helpers: `requireUser` from `@aevryn/auth` → `{id, email?}` (throws "Unauthenticated"); `createServerSupabaseForNext()` (`apps/web/src/lib/supabase-server.ts` — reads `apps/web/.env`).
- `apps/web` has **no `ai` dep** yet — must add `ai` + `@ai-sdk/groq`.
- AGENTS.md caution: check docs before library use; no vitest suite yet. Pre-existing `@aevryn/ui` typecheck failures unrelated (slider.tsx, use-merge-split.tsx, dotmatrix-core.tsx).

## Work State
### Completed
- Verified cloud DB already migrated (17 tables, RLS, realtime, buckets); told user only `on_auth_user_created` trigger missing + gave idempotent SQL; explained "success/no rows" + "already exists" behavior; never re-run migrations / never `db:migrate`/`db:push` against cloud.
- Wrote `packages/agent/src/chat/schemas.ts` (single-source `chatToolSchemas` object with 9 schemas + `ChatToolName` + `CHAT_TOOL_NAMES`).
- Wrote `packages/agent/src/chat/prompt.ts` (`CHAT_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `ChatContext`, `buildChatSystemPrompt`).
- **Rewrote `packages/agent/src/chat/tools.ts`** with proven TS6 pattern: 9 exec consts (`listCapabilitiesExec`…`delegateAgenticWorkExec`) inside `createChatTools` closure; `tool<z.output<typeof S>, Awaited<ReturnType<typeof Exec>>, ChatToolContext>` per entry; `inputSchema: zodSchema(chatToolSchemas.X)`; `ChatToolContext` as type alias (has `userId/workspaceId/threadId/workflowId?/autoApprove/services/onDelegateWork/onToolActivity?`); kept `act()` wrapper, `boundWorkflow`, `formatPlan`, `ChatToolServices`, `ChatToolActivity`; re-exports `type MemoryEntry` + `chatToolNamesUsed()`.
- Deleted `packages/agent/src/scratch-tool-test.ts`; `cd packages/agent && bun run check-types` → **clean** (`tsc --noEmit`, no output).
- Todos updated: schemas/prompt/tools done; stream.ts + barrel in progress; web route + deps pending; typecheck/test pending.
- Recon: `Context = Record<string, unknown>`; provider-utils `tool` overloads at index.d.ts:2139-2145; `FunctionTool`/`BaseTool` shapes (no `name`).

### Active
- Writing `packages/agent/src/chat/stream.ts` (build UIMessages from stored `ChatMessage` rows; content = UIMessageParts jsonb) + `chat/index.ts` barrel + chat export in `packages/agent/src/index.ts`.
- Recon remaining before route: chat message insert pattern (where `chatMessages` written today — blast radius only shows thread-service read usage), `ids.chatMessage`, `chatMessages` column shape, `@aevryn/env` server `GROQ_MODEL`/`GROQ_API_KEY` keys, `createGroq` from `@ai-sdk/groq` usage, apps/web hooks-route pattern (`apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts`), exact `toUIMessageStream`/`createUIMessageStreamResponse` call shape, member/ws auth.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish recon above (codegraph: chat message persistence, env GROQ keys, createGroq, hooks route), then write `packages/agent/src/chat/stream.ts` + `chat/index.ts` + export from `packages/agent/src/index.ts`; re-typecheck agent.
2. Write `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts` (requireUser → body zod parse → thread find/authorize or create → key/model resolve → persist user msg + assistant placeholder `streaming` → `createGroq` + `streamText` → `toUIMessageStream` + `createUIMessageStreamResponse` → `onFinish` upserts assistant message `completed`/`failed` + run status/usage); add `ai` + `@ai-sdk/groq` to `apps/web/package.json`.
3. Typecheck web + agent; live-stream test scenarios 1–3; report.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/agent/src/chat/tools.ts`: rewritten + typechecks clean — reference pattern for any new tools.
- `packages/agent/src/chat/schemas.ts`, `prompt.ts`: written.
- `packages/agent/src/chat/stream.ts`, `packages/agent/src/chat/index.ts`, `packages/agent/src/index.ts`: to create/edit (stream + barrel + export).
- `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: to create; `apps/web/package.json`: add ai deps.
- `node_modules/.bun/@ai-sdk+provider-utils@5.0.39+ab3ed8e9421bfd7b/node_modules/@ai-sdk/provider-utils/dist/index.d.ts`: tool overloads (2139-2145), `FlexibleSchema` (841), `BaseTool` (1927), `Context = Record<string, unknown>` (1501), `ToolExecuteFunction` (1866), own dep zod@3.25.76.
- `packages/workflow/src/services/{key-service,run-service,thread-service,memory-service}.ts` + `memory/types.ts`: route/tool service contracts.
- `packages/auth/src/user.ts` (`getCurrentUser`/`requireUser`), `apps/web/src/lib/supabase-server.ts` (`createServerSupabaseForNext`).
- `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/hooks/[token]/route.ts`, `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts`: route/run patterns to mimic.
- `packages/db/src/schema/chat-message.ts`, `packages/db/src/domain.ts`, `packages/db/src/index.ts`, `ids.ts`: message table + statuses + client/ids.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

2:  * System prompt for the live chat route. Kept adjacent to the durable-run
3:  * decision instructions so the chat model uses the same vocabulary about
4:  * workflows, plans, and the user's workspace.
5:  */
6: export const CHAT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are Aevryn, a work agent embedded in the user's chat. You respond to the user in this thread, use your tools to look things up and act on their workspace, and keep answers concise and plain-text.
7: 
8: Tool usage rules:
9: - Prefer tools over speculation: read the bound plan, check memory, and act through the agents/tools. Do not invent results.
10: - When a plan is bound to this thread, align your work with its steps and mention progress.
11: - When you cannot act immediately (a user decision is needed, or the work is long-running), say what you need instead of guessing.
12: - Long-running or multi-step objectives are delegated to the durable worker via delegateAgenticWork — use it when the objective needs several steps, waiting, webhooks, or scheduled checks that a direct reply cannot complete.
13: - Never echo secrets, API keys, or credentials. Keep httpRequest payloads to what the user asked.
14: 
15: Plan behavior:
16: - Use showPlan to inspect the thread's plan, editPlan to update it, bindWorkflow to establish a new workflow+plan from the user's objective.
17: - When you create a plan with bindWorkflow, cover the objective in concrete, ordered steps.
18: 
19: Memory:
20: - storeMemory records a durable fact/preference for this user. Use it for choices the user states ("always...", "never...", "I prefer...").
21: - searchMemory recalls what you or previous runs already know. Check it before re-doing work.
22: 
23: Finishing:
24: - End with a plain-text answer for the user. If you delegated to the durable worker, tell them it is running and what you asked it to do, and that progress appears as activities in the thread.

## Objective
P5 live chat route + streaming tools built, wired, typechecking. Live-stream tests still pending (need auth session + dev server).

## What I did
- **`packages/agent/src/chat/stream.ts`** (new): `chatRowToUIMessage`, `buildUIMessages`, `textUIMessage`. Maps stored `ChatMessage` rows → `UIMessage[]`; skips `tool` role rows + non-`completed` status. Note: v7 `UIMessage.role` = system|user|assistant only (no `tool`), and no `createdAt` key.
- **`packages/agent/src/chat/index.ts`** barrel + **agent index.ts**: `export * from "./chat"`.
- **`apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`** (new, POST /api/chat, nodejs runtime):
  - `requireUser` (401) → body `{threadId?, workspaceId?, message, autoApprove?, maxOutputTokens?}` (400) → thread authz (404/403) → **key resolve** `KeyService.resolveKey(ws, user, "groq")` → env fallback; missing key = 503.
  - No threadId → creates one (falls back to user's first workspace); auto-titles + touches thread; persists user msg (`completed`) + assistant placeholder (`streaming`).
  - Creates a `trigger:"message"` run per turn (`running` → `completed`/`failed`) + persists tool activities via `onToolActivity`.
  - `createChatTools({ services: {plan,run,thread,memory}, onDelegateWork → inngest.send(threadRunEvent), onToolActivity, autoApprove })`.
  - History: `buildUIMessages` → `convertToModelMessages(history, {tools, ignoreIncompleteToolCalls:true})` — v7 `streamText.messages` expects `ModelMessage[]`, not `UIMessage[]`.
  - `streamText` (model = workspace key `modelName` ?? `env.GROQ_MODEL`) → `toUIMessageStream({stream, tools})` → `createUIMessageStreamResponse({status:200})`.
  - Background `persistAssistantMessage` awaits `result.text` + `result.toolResults`, writes assistant parts (tool parts as `` `tool-${name}` `` cast — template-literal keyed union), records run usage (v7 usage keys = `inputTokens`/`outputTokens`, not prompt/completion).

## Dependency hell fixed (important)
- Web resolutions split into **two `@ai-sdk/provider-utils`** (5.0.36 vs 5.0.39) + **two `@ai-sdk/provider`** (4.0.10/4.0.13) + **two `drizzle-orm`** (same version, different content hashes out of sync) → `createChatTools` `Tool` types mismatched web's `streamText`, and route `eq()` clashed with `@aevryn/db`'s drizzle copy.
- Fixes: root `package.json` `overrides` (`@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.40, `@ai-sdk/provider` 4.0.14, `drizzle-orm` 0.45.2) + `rm -rf node_modules && bun install` → **single copies** (first `bun install` OOM-crashed once; retry OK; overrides alone did nothing).
- Route no longer imports `drizzle-orm` directly: added `ThreadService.updateMessage(id, {status,content})` (`packages/workflow/src/services/thread-service.ts`) + new **`WorkflowService.findById`** (`packages/workflow/src/services/workflow-service.ts`, exported from index) for autoApprove lookup.

## Verification
- `packages/agent`, `packages/workflow`, `packages/inngest`, `apps/web` **check-types all clean** (web still shows only pre-existing `@aevryn/ui` + stale `.next/validator` errors, unrelated).
- `@aevryn/db` has no check-types script (untouched).

## Next Move
1. **Live-stream tests (§K scenarios 1–3)** — blocked on: real Supabase auth cookie (`requireUser`), `GROQ_API_KEY` env, running `next dev` (port 3001), local/cloud DB. Needs user session + env setup; curl can't authenticate without them.

## Relevant Files
- `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts` — streaming route (new)
- `packages/agent/src/chat/{stream,prompt,schemas,tools,index}.ts` — chat core (all written/verified)
- `packages/workflow/src/services/{thread-service,workflow-service}.ts` + `src/index.ts` — persistence helpers (new/edited)
- `packages/agent/src/index.ts`, `apps/web/package.json` (deps +ai/@ai-sdk/groq/@aevryn/agent/@aevryn/db), root `package.json` (overrides)

content.text:
## Objective
- Finish P5 live chat: `POST /api/chat` streaming route in `apps/web` (auth → thread/workspace resolve → key resolve → persist messages → `streamText` via Groq → AI SDK UI stream SSE) with the 9 chat tools; then typecheck web+agent and live-test ARCHITECTURE §K scenarios 1–3.
- Cloud DB: already migrated; only `on_auth_user_created` trigger missing (idempotent SQL already given to user) — do not re-run migrations.

## Important Details
- Repo TS = 6.0.3. ai v7 `tool()` requires explicit generics: `tool<INPUT, OUTPUT, CONTEXT>({ description, inputSchema: zodSchema(schema), execute })`; `INPUT = z.output<typeof schema>`; `CONTEXT` must extend `Record<string, unknown>` (so `ChatToolContext` is a **type alias**, not interface); tool object has **no `name` field**; identity = key in `streamText({ tools: {...} })` map.
- AI SDK v7 confirmed from `node_modules/ai/dist/index.d.ts`:
  - `toUIMessageStream({ stream: result.stream, tools })` standalone; `createUIMessageStreamResponse({ status, statusText?, headers?, stream })`.
  - `UIMessage` role union = `"system" | "user" | "assistant"` (**no "tool"** — tool msgs nested as tool-invocation parts inside assistant msgs; `UIMessage` has **no `createdAt`/`tool` fields**: `UIMessage<unknown, UIDataTypes, UITools>`).
  - `streamText.messages` expects `ModelMessage[]` (UIMessage[] rejected). Use `convertToModelMessages(messages: Array<Omit<UI_MESSAGE,'id'>>, { tools?, ignoreIncompleteToolCalls? })` → `Promise<ModelMessage[]>`.
  - Tool result UIPart shape: `{ type: \`tool-${NAME}\`, toolCallId, input, output, state: "result" }` — literal needs `as unknown as UIMessage["parts"][number]` cast (template-literal keyed union).
  - Usage fields: `totalTokens` / `inputTokens` / `outputTokens` (all possibly `undefined`).
  - `GroqChatModelId` includes `(string & {})` → arbitrary model strings OK; `createGroq({ apiKey }).languageModel(id)`.
- Duplicate-module hell (resolved by full reinstall): root `node_modules/.bun` had twin `drizzle-orm@0.45.2` copies (`+c91d15a7eb3921bb` vs `+c3a0e76489ff6c8e`) and twin `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` (5.0.36 vs 5.0.39) causing `eq()` and `Tool` type conflicts in web. Root `overrides` (ranges, then exact) did **not** dedupe ("no changes"). `rm -rf node_modules && bun install` fixed it: now single `@ai-sdk/provider@4.0.14`, `@ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.40`, `drizzle-orm@0.45.2+c3a0e76489ff6c8e`; 1969 packages, 44s. Root `package.json` still contains exact overrides (harmless).
- Workspace linking: root `node_modules/@aevryn` only has `config`+`env`; each workspace resolves deps from its own `node_modules` (e.g. `apps/web/node_modules/@aevryn/{agent,api,auth,config,db,env,inngest,ui,workflow}`; `packages/workflow/node_modules/drizzle-orm`). All fixed and verified. Summary:

## What happened
- **Bug found**: AI SDK v7 `convertToModelMessages` strips tool parts whose `state` isn't `output-available`/`output-error`/`output-denied`/`approval-responded`, and only emits the tool-result ModelMessage when `providerExecuted === true`. My persisted parts used `state: "result"` → every prior assistant tool result vanished on the next turn (T2 re-ran `listCapabilities` from scratch).
- **Fix**: route + agent tool parts now written as `{ state: "output-available", providerExecuted: true }`. Verified via isolated `convertToModelMessages` test → `tool-call` + `tool-result` both survive (`packages/agent` contract unchanged — fix lives in web route & harness).

## Live E2E results (real Groq + cloud DB, headless)
- Turn 1: `listCapabilities` invoked, threaded SSE chunks stream (17–46 chunks), assistant message persisted `completed` w/ tool part.
- Turn 2: history rebuild now includes prior tool result (converted 2→3 msgs); `storeMemory` executed → `mem_ok` row; all 4 message rows ended `completed`.
- Cleanup: soft-deleted thread + scratch workspaces; scratch files `scratch-chat-e2e.ts` / `scratch-convert-test.ts` deleted.
- `apps/web` typecheck: no errors in `api/chat/route.ts` (only pre-existing `@aevryn/ui` + stale `.next` items).

## Note
- Model called `storeMemory` but skipped `searchMemory` despite the explicit two-tool prompt — model behavior, not code bug; tool plumbing proven working.
- Full UI flow (scenario 3, real auth) still needs `next dev` + a signed-in session — requires your browser + credentials, can't be run headless from here.

## Todo state
- All implementation + typecheck + headless E2E **done**. Only remaining: real-browser UI smoke test (needs your auth session).

## Relevant fix
- `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: tool-part `state`/`providerExecuted` lines (~280) — the only code change this round.

Status of P5 work (see `plan/PLAN.md` + `ARCHITECTURE §K`). Checked items are
done and verified **headless** (typecheck + real-Groq E2E harness run from
`apps/web`); the browser-level scenarios still need a real signed-in session.

## Done

| Item | Verified |
|------|----------|
| `POST /api/chat` route: `streamText` + `toUIMessageStream` + `createUIMessageStreamResponse`, session-aware, member key override → workspace/env key | typecheck + headless E2E |
| Tools: `askQuestion`, `showPlan`, `editPlan`, `bindWorkflow`, `storeMemory`, `searchMemory`, `httpRequest`, `delegateAgenticWork`, `listCapabilities` | `listCapabilities` ran; `storeMemory` → `mem_ok` row |
| Tool schemas = zod; `AskUserQuestion` schema shared (lives in `@aevryn/agent`) | — |
| Auto-approve honored in system prompt (route uses body override ?? bound workflow `autoApprove`) | — |
| Quality/token slider: route accepts `maxOutputTokens` (64..32768); UI wire is P7 | route-only |

## Unplanned fixes made here

- Duplicate package copies (`@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.36/5.0.39,
  `drizzle-orm` twin content hashes) breaking `Tool`/`eq()` types at web scope.
  Fixed by root `overrides` (`@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.40, `@ai-sdk/provider`
  4.0.14, `drizzle-orm` 0.45.2) + `rm -rf node_modules && bun install`.
- `ThreadService.updateMessage(id, {status, content})` added to
  `packages/workflow/src/services/thread-service.ts` so the route avoids
  importing `drizzle-orm` directly.
- `WorkflowService.findById` added (`packages/workflow/src/services/workflow-service.ts`),
  exported from `packages/workflow/src/index.ts`.
- AI SDK v7 `convertToModelMessages` tool-part round-trip: persisted tool parts
  must use `state: "output-available"` + `providerExecuted: true` (NOT
  `"result"`) or every prior assistant tool result is silently dropped from
  later history. Fixed in `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`.

- [ ] `generateImage` / `transcribeAudio` (lazy per configured model)
- [ ] Attachments: image/pdf → LLM-readable parts
- [ ] System "auto-approved" message row when auto-approve is on
- [ ] Shared `AskUserQuestion` schema actually imported by web (schema is in agent only)
- [ ] §K scenarios 1–3 end-to-end in a real browser (needs `next dev` + signed-in Supabase session; headless portion already proven)

## Next phase

- P6: durable `/api/queue` (sequential drain), image compression → `files`,
  `ChatMessage` attachment props, soft-archive trash + purge, auto-title,
  export/import, re-run last run, share preview.
- P7: UI wiring (zustand + realtime + widgets), token slider surfaced to client.

content.text:
## Objective
- Finish P6/commit item 10 `feat(queue)`: durable sequential queue delivery, image compression → `files`, soft-archive purge (PLAN.md P6 lines 102–115). Then typecheck + commit (one-line subject only).

## Important Details
- **User directive:** commit messages = one-line subject, NO extended descriptions from now on.
- Commit plan (PLAN.md): max 12 commits, ≤ one phase each. Item 9 `feat(chat)` committed `e8ddbe3`. Item 10 scope = queue + image compression + soft-archive purge.
- AI SDK v7 tool-part round-trip fix (verified): persisted tool parts must be `{ state: "output-available", providerExecuted: true }` — `"result"` gets silently dropped by `convertToModelMessages` (requires state ∈ output-available/output-error/output-denied/approval-responded + `providerExecuted === true` for tool-result ModelMessage).
- Queue design (implemented): `chat_messages` rows `status="queued"` + `queue_order`; `deliverNext` flips top queued row → `completed`; `hasActiveRun` = latest run status ∉ {completed,failed,cancelled}; thread-runner terminal-complete sends `queue/deliver` event → `queue-deliver` fn pops one, creates run (`trigger:"message"`), sends `threadRunEvent` → sequential drain.
- Duplicate-deps hell resolved permanently: root overrides (`@ai-sdk/provider-utils 5.0.40`, `@ai-sdk/provider 4.0.14`, `drizzle-orm 0.45.2`) + `rm -rf node_modules && bun install`; single copies; all typechecks clean post-reinstall.
- TS 6.0.3; ai v7 (`ai ^7.0.93`, `@ai-sdk/groq ^4.0.37`); workspace `@aevryn/*` symlinks resolve from each package's own `node_modules`.
- `apps/web/.env` has GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_MODEL (default `openai/gpt-oss-20b`), cloud DATABASE_URL + Supabase creds → headless E2E possible, browser test blocked on real auth session.
- Pre-existing unrelated typecheck failures: `@aevryn/ui` slider/use-merge-split/dotmatrix-core, stale `.next/validator.ts` `[trpc]` route.
- inngest = 4.20.0. `createFunction` style used: `{ id, retries, triggers: [{ event }] }` (thread-runner, queue-deliver); schedule-tick uses 2-arg form — cron trigger support still being verified.
- Schema ready: `chat_messages.queue_order` + `status "queued"`; `threads.deletedAt`; `files` table (bucket `"chat-attachments"`, `compressed` bool, `sizeBytes` bigint mode number); `ids.file()` (`fil_`); `ThreadService.{softDelete,restore,hardDelete}` exist.
- Cloud DB migrated; only `on_auth_user_created` trigger missing (SQL given to user). No migration reruns.
- Headless E2E note: model often calls tools without text output; that's model behavior, not bug. Memory store → `mem_ok` verified.

## Work State
### Completed
- P5 fully shipped + committed: `e8ddbe3 feat(chat)` (960 insertions, 13 files).
- Headless live E2E (real Groq + cloud DB): streaming chunks, `listCapabilities`, `storeMemory` → `mem_ok`, persistence round-trip, message rows all `completed`; scratch files deleted; cleanup of scratch rows via `db.execute("DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE name = 'E2E scratch'")`.
- `convertToModelMessages` tool-part fix applied in route + verified in isolation (tool-call + tool-result both emitted).
- `final-docs/REMAINING.md` written: P5 done/gaps audit, unplanned fixes, blocked browser test, P6/P7 pointers.
- P6 queue core written + typechecked clean:
  - `packages/workflow/src/services/queue-service.ts`: `listQueued`, `enqueue` (tx, max queueOrder), `findById`, `updateContent`, `remove`, `reorder`, `deliverNext` (tx pop), `hasActiveRun`; exported in `packages/workflow/src/index.ts`.
  - `packages/inngest/src/events.ts`: `queueDeliverEvent` `"queue/deliver"` + schema; exported via `packages/inngest/src/index.ts`.
  - `packages/inngest/src/functions/queue-deliver.ts`: sequential drain fn (skips thread-gone/run-active/queue-empty/empty-content; creates run; sends `threadRunEvent`).
  - `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts`: best-effort `inngest.send(queueDeliverEvent)` when `finalizedStatus === "completed"`.
  - `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: gate — `if (await queueService.hasActiveRun(threadId))` → `queueService.enqueue` + JSON `{data:{queued:true,messageId}}` (before inserts).
  - Queue routes: `apps/web/src/app/api/queue/route.ts` (GET list `?threadId`, POST enqueue), `deliver/route.ts` (POST → inngest.send, 409 if active run), `reorder/route.ts` (POST orderedIds), `[id]/route.ts` (PATCH text, DELETE remove) — all with requireUser + member access check.
  - `packages/workflow`, `packages/inngest`, `apps/web` check-types clean for all queue/chat files.

### Active
- Todo state: queue-service/enqueue/deliverNext done (=`QueueService.hasActiveRun` implemented, not separate `RunService.hasActive`); routes done; chat gate done. Remaining: image compression + `/api/files`; purge job; threads delete/restore routes; final typecheck + commit item 10.
- Last command: verifying inngest 4.20.0 cron trigger support (`rg "cron"` in inngest dist types) to write the purge cron.
- Uncommitted P6 working tree: queue-service.ts, queue routes, events.ts, queue-deliver.ts, thread-runner.ts (queue trigger), workflow index.ts, chat route (gate).

### Blocked
- None. (Browser §K scenario test still needs user's signed-in Supabase session + `next dev`; P7 UI.)

## Next Move
1. Verify inngest cron trigger pattern for 4.20.0 (how schedule-tick gets invoked — cron in config vs external), then write purge: `ThreadService.listDeletedOlderThan(days)` + inngest `thread-purge` cron (daily, hard-delete threads deleted >30d via existing `hardDelete`), export from `packages/inngest/src/index.ts`.
2. Image compression: client util (canvas → WebP q0.8 ≤2000px) + `POST /api/files` (auth, member check, supabase storage upload to `chat-attachments`, insert `files` row, guard `createBucket` best-effort service-role).
3. Threads soft-archive routes: `DELETE /api/threads/[id]` (softDelete), `POST /api/threads/[id]/restore` (restore).
4. Typecheck all touched packages; commit item 10 with one-line subject `feat(queue): ...`.

## Relevant Files
- `packages/workflow/src/services/queue-service.ts` (new): queue core.
- `packages/inngest/src/functions/queue-deliver.ts` (new), `packages/inngest/src/events.ts` (`queueDeliverEvent`), `packages/inngest/src/functions/thread-runner.ts` (deliver trigger), `packages/inngest/src/index.ts`.
- `apps/web/src/app/api/queue/{route.ts,deliver/route.ts,reorder/route.ts,[id]/route.ts}` (new).
- `apps/web/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`: queue gate + committed tool-part state fix.
- `final-docs/REMAINING.md`, `final-docs/plan/PLAN.md` (P6 102–115, commit plan 147–169), `final-docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §K.
- `packages/db/src/schema/{chat-message,file,thread}.ts`: queue/archive/storage schema.
- `packages/workflow/src/services/thread-service.ts`: softDelete/restore/hardDelete (+ need `listDeletedOlderThan`).
- Git: `e8ddbe3` = item 9 done; item 10 uncommitted.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

## Important Details
- Commit discipline: one-line subject ONLY (no body). Commit plan ≤12 commits, ≤1 phase each. Branch `backend/rewrite`. Done: item 9 `e8ddbe3 feat(chat)`, item 10 `edabe62 feat(queue)`. Next: item 11 = P7 `ui(app)`.
- User clarified mock data location: NOT in `apps/web` workspace pages — those are stubs/redirects. Mocks live in `packages/ui` (`sidebar-preset/nav-data.ts` has comment "NEWTODO change with real data via dataabse").
- User directive on delegation: **use own/explore agents, NOT `cavecrew-investigator`** (fails: "Model not found: haiku/"). Verified `subagent_type:"explore"` works.
- P7 scope (PLAN.md 117–140): stores useAuthStore/useThreadStore/useComposerStore/useSidebarStore/useNotificationsStore/useUIStore; `useRealtimeThread(threadId)` (merges broadcast rows); real `/workspace/[workspaceId]/[threadId]` chat load + router push w/o reload + composer center→bottom + header rename/workflow dropdown; AppSidebar real NAV_SECTIONS (groups from DB incl. locked INVITES system group) + search + notifications chip/mark-read + run-all/stop-all PARALLEL (groups ≤5) + per-item run/stop/rename/share/delete; WorkflowDialog (rename Instructions→Agent + Environment tab w/ per-provider MODEL PRESETS searchable + free-text override + General/Share/Plan/Memories real + delete-confirm); Settings/Profile dialogs (Members: InputCopy link + role Select owner/editor/viewer + Remove; Profile "use my own keys" toggle); Invite + thread-share UI; One-Run model (Run btn + LLM both fire `thread/run`; approval dialog = 4 buttons max); verify §K scenarios 4–8.
- Verify targets (§K 4–8): close tab mid-run → reopen renders state; queued "delete workflow" delivers SEQUENTIALLY after run completes; auto-approve ON → instant approval + system message; workspace invite → switcher badge + owner keys unless invitee "use my own keys"; thread share → guest INVITES group + header badge + own keys + revoke removes instantly; deleted thread → soft-archive/trash 30 days → recoverable → purge.
- inngest 4.20.0 cron trigger verified via sourcemap: `Trigger = CronTrigger | EventTrigger`; `CronTrigger = { cron: string; jitter?: string }`; `export function cron<T extends string>(schedule: T) { return { cron: schedule }; }` — trigger object form `{ cron: "0 0 * * *" }` confirmed.

**Scope (from PLAN commit 11):** zustand stores + realtime + sidebar/header/chat wired to DB + one-Run model. Commit 12 (dialogs env/share, settings split, invite UI, badges, share preview) stays out of this session.

### Architecture decisions
1. **Reads = Server Components → hydrate stores.** Workspace layout `/workspace/[workspaceId]/[threadId]` is an RSC: it calls Supabase (RLS, via `createServerSupabaseForNext`) + existing services (ThreadService/NotificationService/MemberService/run enums) to fetch thread, messages, runs, groups, notifications, profile. Serializes to JSON → client `<WorkspaceShell>` seeds zustand stores with it. No new read-only REST API needed (fits codebase, zero RLS duplication).
2. **Mutations + streaming = API routes** (existing pattern, service-backed): `POST /api/chat` (exists), `GET/POST /api/queue` (exists), new `POST /api/threads/[id]/run` (create run + `threadRunEvent`), `POST /api/runs/[id]/stop` (cancel), thread rename/restore (exists), `POST /api/notifications/read`. Sidebar fan-out run-all/stop-all = client loops POSTs, cap 5 parallel.
3. **Realtime = supabase-js channel** on `chat_messages` + `run_activities` + `runs` + `notifications` (postgres_changes, RLS already protected; glue migration publishes all tables) → `useRealtimeThread(threadId)` merges rows into stores. Same channel grounds queue sends (status='queued' rows) without polling.

### Files to create
- `apps/web/src/stores/`: `auth-store.ts`, `thread-store.ts`, `composer-store.ts`, `sidebar-store.ts`, `notifications-store.ts`, `ui-store.ts` (zustand).

content.text:
## Objective
- Build commit 11 `ui(app)` (P7): wire real DB data into the workspace UI — zustand stores + supabase realtime + sidebar/header/chat + one-Run model; commit with one-line subject on branch `backend/rewrite`.
- In progress: stores + streaming/realtime hooks + 4 API routes done; approval/notification routes, components, RSC pages, typecheck, commit remain.

## Important Details
- Commit 11 only; commit 12 `ui(workspace)` deferred. One-line subject; ≤12 commits; ≤1 phase/commit.
- Reads = RSC hydration (`createServerSupabaseForNext` + services/RLS) → serialize JSON (contract types in `apps/web/src/types/workspace.ts`); mutations/streaming = API routes; realtime = supabase-js `postgres_changes`.
- Streaming design (final): NO optimistic assistant message in store. Hook `use-thread-chat` posts `/api/chat`, exposes local `streamingText` state. ChatView renders canonical store messages + `streamingText`; hides DB assistant rows with status=`streaming` (content `[]`) until the persisted UPDATE (status=completed, full parts) arrives. Optimistic user messages use `temp-user-*` ids; realtime chat_messages handler drops matching temp when the persisted row arrives. SSE `start` part carries NO messageId (verified in `ai` dist sources) → cannot key optimistic assistant to DB id; DB rows via realtime are canonical.
- Queue: DB-durable (chat_messages status=queued, `QueueService.enqueue`). Composer queue mirrors DB via `refreshQueue()` → GET `/api/queue?threadId`; on `/api/chat` → `{data:{queued:true}}` keep thread active; server-side `queue-deliver` drains sequentially (queueDeliverEvent → threadRunEvent). Edit/reorder/delete via existing `/api/queue/[id]` PATCH/DELETE + `/api/queue/reorder`.
- One-Run model: Run button = `POST /api/threads/[id]/run` (run trigger `rerun` + send `threadRunEvent`; prompt falls back to last user message). Stop = `POST /api/runs/[id]/stop` (cancel if status in ACTIVE set).
- Approval resume (recon, not yet built): `runService.resumeTriggeredBy(runId)` flips sleeping/waiting/awaiting_approval → pending, then send `threadRunEvent` with `approvedToolNames`. Approve/approve-run → `ApprovalService.resolve` approved (+ toolName to approvedToolNames); deny → resolve denied; both resume. Prompt fallback = run.promptSnapshot ?? last user message.
- `InputMessage`/`QueuedStack` contracts: `onSend(value, files, meta?.queuedId)`, `queue: QueuedMessage[]`; InputMessage auto-dispatches next queued item on streaming→idle edge.
- API route pattern: `jsonError`/`jsonOk`/`requireUser`/`assertThreadAccess` (ref `/api/queue/route.ts`); services instantiated at module top; runtime nodejs + force-dynamic.
- Typecheck command: `cd apps/web && bunx tsc --noEmit`; only 4 pre-existing errors (stale `.next/types/validator.ts` [trpc], `card.tsx` ×2 Link/href, `dotmatrix-core.tsx` CSSProperties). packages/ui LSP errors (input-message.tsx, workflow-dialog.tsx, notifications-dialog.tsx) are pre-existing mock noise — not in tsc filter.
- RLS reads: groups select = own or member; threads = owner/member/thread_shares; runs = canReadThread(thread); run_activities = exists runs+canReadThread; notifications = user_id scoped; approval_requests = canReadThread(thread_id); workflows = user or member.
- Files: commit 11 sends text only; `/api/files` uploads remain preview-only (ingestion deferred to later phase).
- Env/deps settled: zustand ^5 in web; `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.102` installed; `ai` v7 exports `index`/`internal`/`test` only.

## Work State
### Completed
- Todo list set (8 items: stores, chat hook, realtime hook, routes, components, RSC pages, typecheck, commit).
- `apps/web/src/types/workspace.ts` — all Serialized* types, `WorkspaceHydration`, `ThreadHydration`, `WorkspaceThread`.
- 6 zustand stores: `stores/auth-store.ts` (user/profile/workspaces/activeWorkspaceId/accessToken + `isEditorOfWorkspace`), `stores/thread-store.ts` (groups/threads/messagesByThread/runsByThread/activitiesByThread/approvalsByThread + upsert/append/setMessageStatus/hydrate/remove/clear; `StoredMessage = SerializedMessage | StreamMessage`), `stores/composer-store.ts` (value/files/queue/isActive/error/quality default 4096 + setQuality), `stores/sidebar-store.ts` (collapsed/search/notifications/unreadCount + markRead/markAllRead/pushNotification), `stores/ui-store.ts` (notifications/settings/rename/share/workflow dialog flags).
- `hooks/use-thread-chat.ts` — SSE parser (`data:` lines, text-delta/finish/error), optimistic user, `streamingText`, send/stop/dismissError, exported `refreshQueue(threadId)`.
- `hooks/use-realtime-thread.ts` — postgres_changes channels `thread:${threadId}` (chat_messages, runs, run_activities unfiltered+client-side run check, approval_requests) and `notifications:${userId}`; snake_case→camel mappers; queued rows trigger refreshQueue; temp-user reconciliation.
- API routes: `POST /api/threads/[id]/run`, `POST /api/runs/[id]/stop`, `PATCH /api/threads/[id]` (rename / bind+unbind workflow w/ validation / shareEnabled, editor-gated), `POST /api/threads` (create, isEditor-gated).
- Early `bunx tsc --noEmit` in apps/web clean beyond 4 pre-existing errors.
- Prior: P6 committed `edabe62` (feat(queue)); `apps/web/src/lib/image.ts` (compressImage WebP/JPEG); full P7 recon done.

### Active
- Todo 4 partial: `POST /api/notifications/read` and `POST /api/approvals/[id]` not yet written.
- Todos 5 (components), 6 (RSC pages), 7 (typecheck), 8 (commit) pending.

### Blocked
- None new. Pre-existing 4 web typecheck failures (unrelated, accepted for this commit). `cavecrew-investigator` subagent unusable — use `subagent_type:"explore"` only.

## Next Move
1. Add `POST /api/notifications/read` (body `{ids?: string[]}`; empty = all) using `NotificationService.markRead(id, userId)` / `markAllRead(userId)`.
